senses.en: someone who listens to a person, programme, or performance

ex.en: My sister is a patient listener when I feel worried.
ex.zh: 我感到担忧时，姐姐总会耐心倾听。

ex.en: A good listener can help colleagues resolve disagreements by understanding different perspectives before offering advice.
ex.zh: 善于倾听的人会先理解不同观点再提出建议，从而帮助同事解决分歧。

col: a good listener｜善于倾听的人
tip: listener指听的人；listen后接宾语须用to。

senses.en: Try to hurt someone or criticize something strongly
An act of violence or strong criticism
A sudden period of illness or severe symptoms

ex.en: The goose attacked my bag when I approached the pond.
ex.zh: 我走近池塘时，那只鹅突然啄起我的包。

ex.en: Critics attacked the proposal because it offered little support for families living in poverty.
ex.zh: 批评者猛烈抨击这项提案，因为它几乎没有为贫困家庭提供支持。

col: come under attack｜遭到攻击或抨击
attack a proposal｜抨击一项提案
tip: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用an attack on。

senses.en: to move air, or move because of moving air
an event that causes disappointment, difficulty, or loss
a hard hit with a hand or object

ex.en: A cold wind blew leaves across the empty playground.
ex.zh: 一阵冷风把树叶吹过空荡荡的操场。

ex.en: The closure of the local factory dealt a serious blow to employment opportunities in the region.
ex.zh: 当地工厂的关闭严重打击了该地区的就业机会。

col: blow out a candle｜吹灭蜡烛
deal a blow to｜给……造成打击
tip: 动词变化为blow–blew–blown。

senses.en: a room used for keeping supplies or unused things

ex.en: The spare chairs are stacked neatly in the storeroom.
ex.zh: 备用椅子整齐地堆放在储藏室里。

ex.en: Schools should keep emergency supplies in a secure storeroom that staff can access quickly when necessary.
ex.zh: 学校应将应急物资存放在安全的储藏室里，确保教职员工在必要时能够迅速取用。

col: keep something in a storeroom｜把某物存放在储藏室
tip: storeroom是房间；warehouse通常指较大的仓库。

senses.en: free someone or something from an unwanted thing

ex.en: We finally got rid of the broken garden chairs.
ex.zh: 我们终于处理掉了那些坏掉的花园椅子。

ex.en: Cities can rid their streets of excessive litter by improving waste collection and encouraging responsible behaviour.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过改进垃圾收集并鼓励负责任的行为，清除街道上过多的垃圾。

col: rid something of｜清除某物中的
tip: 牢记get rid of；rid A of B表示清除A中的B。

senses.en: Relating to the region around the South Pole.
The region surrounding the South Pole, including Antarctica.

ex.en: We watched a film about penguins on Antarctic ice.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于南极冰面上企鹅的影片。

ex.en: Scientists monitor Antarctic ice to understand how rising global temperatures affect sea levels worldwide.
ex.zh: 科学家监测南极冰层，以了解全球气温升高如何影响世界各地的海平面。

tip: 名词用the Antarctic；Antarctica专指南极洲。
note: 首字母已改为标准大写：Antarctic。

senses.en: Used to confirm something or emphasize that it is true.
Used to add information that strengthens a previous statement.

ex.en: The soup was very tasty indeed, so I had more.
ex.zh: 这汤确实非常好喝，所以我又喝了一些。

ex.en: Public transport can reduce congestion; indeed, reliable bus services may persuade many commuters to stop driving.
ex.zh: 公共交通能够缓解拥堵；事实上，可靠的公交服务可能使许多通勤者放弃开车。

col: very useful indeed｜确实非常有用
tip: 可用very＋形容词＋indeed加强语气。

senses.en: an area of a country or the world
a particular area of the body

ex.en: This region is famous for its apples and cheese.
ex.zh: 这个地区以苹果和奶酪闻名。

ex.en: Improved transport links could attract more businesses to the region and create jobs for local residents.
ex.zh: 改善交通联系可以吸引更多企业进入该地区，并为当地居民创造就业机会。

tip: in the region of接金额等，表示“大约”。

senses.en: air moving into or out of your lungs
one act of taking air into your lungs

ex.en: Her breath formed a cloud in the cold air.
ex.zh: 她呼出的气在冷空气中形成了一团白雾。

ex.en: Taking a slow, deep breath can help students manage anxiety before an important examination.
ex.zh: 缓慢地深呼吸一次，有助于学生缓解重要考试前的焦虑。

col: take a deep breath｜深吸一口气
out of breath｜上气不接下气
tip: breath是名词；breathe是动词，末尾读/ð/。

senses.en: previously owned or used by someone else
learned from others rather than through direct experience
from a previous owner, or through another person's account

ex.en: My second-hand bicycle still rides smoothly after years of use.
ex.zh: 我的二手自行车用了多年，骑起来仍很顺畅。

ex.en: Buying second-hand furniture can reduce household spending and prevent usable goods from ending up in landfill.
ex.zh: 购买二手家具能减少家庭开支，并避免尚可使用的物品最终被填埋。

tip: 既可指物品用过，也可指信息并非亲身获得。

senses.en: a teacher who guides individuals or small groups
to teach someone individually or in a small group

ex.en: My tutor helped me understand fractions using paper circles.
ex.zh: 我的辅导老师用圆形纸片帮我理解了分数。

ex.en: A personal tutor can help students develop effective study habits and address specific learning difficulties.
ex.zh: 私人教师可以帮助学生养成有效的学习习惯，并解决具体的学习困难。

col: tutor someone in maths｜辅导某人数学
tip: tutor强调个别或小组辅导，不一定是教授。

senses.en: A condition causing illness after contact with a normally harmless substance

ex.en: My brother has an allergy to peanuts and walnuts.
ex.zh: 我哥哥对花生和核桃过敏。

ex.en: Schools should have clear procedures for helping children who experience a severe food allergy reaction.
ex.zh: 学校应制定明确流程，为出现严重食物过敏反应的儿童提供帮助。

tip: 常用have an allergy to；to后接引起过敏的物质。

senses.en: A boat carrying passengers or vehicles across water regularly.
To carry people or goods between places, often repeatedly.

ex.en: We took the ferry across the lake this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上我们乘渡船穿过了湖。

ex.en: Reliable ferry services connect island communities with mainland hospitals, schools, and employment opportunities throughout the year.
ex.zh: 可靠的轮渡服务全年将岛屿社区与大陆的医院、学校和就业机会连接起来。

tip: 复数为ferries；动词也可指用车反复接送。

senses.en: the condition of someone or something at a particular time
a country, its government, or a region within a country
to express something clearly in speech or writing

ex.en: The kitchen was in a terrible state after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，厨房一片狼藉。

ex.en: The report states that reliable public transport is essential for reducing dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 报告指出，可靠的公共交通对于减少对私家车的依赖至关重要。

col: in a good state｜处于良好状态
tip: state作动词较正式，可接that从句；名词可指状态或国家。

senses.en: a vertical arrangement of items or a printed page section
a regular newspaper or magazine feature on a particular subject
a tall upright structure, often supporting a roof

ex.en: Put the prices in the column beside each item.
ex.zh: 把价格填在每件商品旁边的那一列里。

ex.en: The newspaper's weekly science column helps readers understand how new discoveries may affect everyday life.
ex.zh: 这家报纸每周的科学专栏帮助读者了解新发现可能如何影响日常生活。

col: a column of figures｜一列数字
tip: column 是竖列，row 是横行；词尾 n 不发音。

senses.en: Help someone remember something they need to do or know
Make someone think of a similar person, thing, or experience

ex.en: Please remind me to take my umbrella before we leave.
ex.zh: 出门前请提醒我带伞。

ex.en: Schools should regularly remind students to protect their personal information when using online learning platforms.
ex.zh: 学校应定期提醒学生，在使用在线学习平台时保护个人信息。

col: remind someone to do something｜提醒某人做某事
remind someone of something｜使某人想起某事
tip: 提醒去做用remind sb to do；使想起用of。

senses.en: to encourage something to develop or become more widely accepted
to give someone a higher position at work
to attract attention to something to increase interest or sales

ex.en: Our local club promotes cycling through free weekend rides.
ex.zh: 我们当地的俱乐部通过免费的周末骑行活动推广骑车。

ex.en: Schools can promote healthier lifestyles by providing nutritious meals and encouraging students to take regular exercise.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过提供营养餐并鼓励学生定期锻炼来倡导更健康的生活方式。

col: promote economic growth｜促进经济增长
be promoted to manager｜获晋升为经理
tip: 晋升到某职位用be promoted to＋职位。

senses.en: A large group of musicians playing different instruments together.

ex.en: The orchestra began playing as the lights dimmed.
ex.zh: 灯光暗下来时，管弦乐队开始演奏。

ex.en: Public funding helps the local orchestra offer affordable concerts and introduce classical music to younger audiences.
ex.zh: 公共资助帮助当地管弦乐队举办票价亲民的音乐会，并向年轻观众介绍古典音乐。

col: conduct an orchestra｜指挥管弦乐队
play in an orchestra｜在管弦乐队演奏
tip: 指整个乐队；成员通常演奏弦乐、管乐及打击乐器。

senses.en: Relating to the body rather than the mind.
Existing as something real that can be touched or measured.
Relating to natural forces, matter, and energy.

ex.en: Gardening gives me plenty of physical exercise every weekend.
ex.zh: 每个周末做园艺活都让我得到充分的身体锻炼。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can improve public health and reduce the financial pressure on national healthcare systems.
ex.zh: 规律的体育活动能够改善公众健康，并减轻国家医疗体系的财政压力。

tip: physical偏身体或物质；physiological指生理的。

senses.en: A hollow tube that carries liquid or gas.
To carry liquid or gas through pipes.
A small bowl with a tube used for smoking tobacco.

ex.en: Water dripped from a broken pipe under the sink.
ex.zh: 水从洗涤槽下面一根破裂的管子里滴下来。

ex.en: Replacing damaged water pipes can help cities conserve resources and ensure a reliable supply of clean drinking water.
ex.zh: 更换受损水管可以帮助城市节约资源，并确保清洁饮用水的可靠供应。

col: pipe water to｜用管道把水输送到
tip: pipe可作动词：pipe water to把水输送到某处。

senses.en: one thousand million
an extremely large quantity, usually expressed as billions

ex.en: The science museum displayed a rock a billion years old.
ex.zh: 科学博物馆展出了一块有十亿年历史的岩石。

ex.en: Governments spend billions of dollars on transport infrastructure to support economic growth and connect isolated communities.
ex.zh: 各国政府投入数十亿美元建设交通基础设施，以促进经济增长并连接偏远社区。

tip: 具体数值后不加s；泛指数十亿用billions of。

senses.en: Related to medicine or the treatment of illness.
An examination to check a person's health.

ex.en: The hotel called for medical help when a guest fainted.
ex.zh: 一位客人晕倒后，酒店呼叫了医疗救助。

ex.en: Governments should improve access to medical services in rural areas where hospitals are often far away.
ex.zh: 政府应改善农村地区的医疗服务可及性，因为那里的医院往往距离很远。

tip: medical作名词多用于英式英语，指体检，不指医生。

senses.en: Long narrow bands differing in colour from the surrounding surface

ex.en: My favourite shirt has blue stripes across the front.
ex.zh: 我最喜欢的衬衫正面有蓝色条纹。

ex.en: Researchers investigate how zebra stripes may discourage biting insects, potentially revealing useful strategies for protecting livestock.
ex.zh: 研究人员探究斑马条纹如何阻止叮咬昆虫，这可能为保护牲畜提供有用策略。

col: black and white stripes｜黑白条纹
tip: stripes是stripe的复数；“条纹的”用striped。

senses.en: someone who prepares written material or manages a publication
someone who selects and arranges recorded images or sound
software used to change digital content

ex.en: The editor suggested a clearer ending for my story.
ex.zh: 编辑建议我给故事写一个更清楚的结尾。

ex.en: A newspaper editor must balance the public's right to information with respect for individual privacy.
ex.zh: 报纸编辑必须在公众知情权与尊重个人隐私之间取得平衡。

col: editor of a magazine｜杂志编辑
tip: editor可指编辑人员，也可指编辑软件。

senses.en: Something made by combining two or more different things.

ex.en: Stir the mixture until it becomes smooth and creamy.
ex.zh: 搅拌混合物，直到它变得顺滑绵密。

ex.en: Successful cities offer a mixture of affordable housing, reliable transport, and accessible public spaces.
ex.zh: 成功的城市兼具可负担的住房、可靠的交通和方便使用的公共空间。

tip: a mixture of 后可接物质，也可接情感等抽象事物。

senses.en: To make something happen later than expected or planned.
A period of waiting before something happens or continues.

ex.en: Heavy snow delayed our flight until the next morning.
ex.zh: 大雪使我们的航班延误到第二天早上。

ex.en: Delays in public transport can reduce productivity and discourage people from leaving their cars at home.
ex.zh: 公共交通的延误会降低生产效率，并使人们不愿放弃开车出行。

tip: 动词后接动名词：delay doing，不用to do。

senses.en: The sound or action of laughing

ex.en: Laughter filled the kitchen when the puppy sneezed.
ex.zh: 小狗一打喷嚏，厨房里便充满了笑声。

ex.en: Shared laughter can strengthen social bonds and help people manage stress in demanding work environments.
ex.zh: 一起欢笑可以增进人际联系，帮助人们应对高压工作环境中的压力。

col: a burst of laughter｜一阵笑声
tip: laughter不可数；表示“一阵笑声”用a burst of laughter。

senses.en: To remove hair from skin using a razor.
To remove thin pieces or reduce something by a small amount.
An act of removing facial hair with a razor.

ex.en: I shave every morning before leaving for work.
ex.zh: 我每天早晨出门上班前都会刮胡子。

ex.en: Improved transport connections could shave several minutes off daily journeys and encourage more people to commute by train.
ex.zh: 改善交通衔接可以缩短几分钟的日常行程，并鼓励更多人乘火车通勤。

tip: 过去式shaved；过去分词shaved或shaven。

senses.en: To become curved or make something curved.
To move your body downwards or forwards from the waist.
A curved section of a road, river, or other long object.

ex.en: Bend the wire gently to make a small hook.
ex.zh: 轻轻弯曲铁丝，做成一个小钩子。

ex.en: Drivers should reduce their speed before approaching a sharp bend, especially when road conditions are poor.
ex.zh: 驾驶员在接近急弯前应减速，尤其是在路况不佳时。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为bent；bend down表示弯下腰。

senses.en: a young sheep
meat from a young sheep, eaten as food

ex.en: A small lamb followed its mother across the field.
ex.zh: 一只小羊跟着妈妈穿过田野。

ex.en: Producing lamb requires land and water, so its environmental impact should be considered when planning sustainable diets.
ex.zh: 生产羊羔肉需要土地和水，因此规划可持续饮食时应考虑其环境影响。

tip: 词尾b不发音；指小羊可数，指肉不可数。

senses.en: Pleasure and satisfaction in achievements, qualities, or people you value.
Respect for yourself, sometimes involving an exaggerated sense of importance.
To feel especially pleased about your own qualities or achievements.

ex.en: Her face shone with pride as she displayed her painting.
ex.zh: 她展示画作时，脸上洋溢着自豪。

ex.en: Schools can foster community pride by encouraging students to participate in projects that improve their local environment.
ex.zh: 学校可以鼓励学生参与改善当地环境的项目，从而培养社区自豪感。

col: hurt someone's pride｜伤害某人的自尊
pride yourself on｜以自身的……为傲
tip: 动词用pride oneself on；形容词用proud of。

senses.en: a soft hat, often with a stiff front part
a cover fitted over the end or opening of something
to set a maximum amount or level for something

ex.en: He pulled on his cap before leaving for practice.
ex.zh: 他戴上帽子后出门去训练。

ex.en: Governments could cap annual rent increases to protect households from sudden rises in housing costs.
ex.zh: 政府可以限制年度租金涨幅，以保护家庭免受住房成本骤增的影响。

col: a cap on fees｜费用上限
tip: cap作动词指设上限；a cap on后接受限项目。

senses.en: An event causing great damage, suffering, or loss.
Something that goes extremely badly or fails completely.

ex.en: Dinner was a disaster because I burned the rice.
ex.zh: 晚餐糟透了，因为我把米饭烧焦了。

ex.en: Effective early warning systems can reduce the damage caused by natural disasters and help communities recover more quickly.
ex.zh: 有效的预警系统可以减少自然灾害造成的损失，并帮助社区更快恢复。

tip: 也可夸张形容失败：The party was a disaster。

senses.en: A juicy fruit with fuzzy skin and a large hard stone
Having a pale pinkish orange colour

ex.en: She sliced a ripe peach into her breakfast bowl.
ex.zh: 她把一个熟桃切成片，放进早餐碗里。

ex.en: Peach growers may face reduced harvests when unusually warm winters disrupt the trees' natural flowering cycle.
ex.zh: 冬季异常温暖会扰乱桃树的自然开花周期，桃农可能因此面临减产。

tip: 桃核英式常说 stone，美式常说 pit。

senses.en: someone who enters a building illegally to steal things

ex.en: A burglar climbed through the window while everyone was away.
ex.zh: 大家都不在家时，一名窃贼爬窗而入。

ex.en: Improved street lighting and secure doors may discourage burglars from targeting homes in residential areas.
ex.zh: 改善街道照明并安装牢固的门，可能使窃贼不敢对住宅区的房屋下手。

col: catch a burglar｜抓住入室盗贼
tip: burglar指入室盗贼；robber通常指使用威胁的劫匪。

senses.en: A person who sends a message, letter or package.

ex.en: The sender wrapped the parcel carefully before posting it.
ex.zh: 寄件人在邮寄前仔细包好了包裹。

ex.en: Email users should verify the sender before opening attachments to reduce the risk of digital fraud.
ex.zh: 电子邮件用户应在打开附件前核实发件人，以降低网络诈骗的风险。

tip: sender是发送者，recipient是接收者。

senses.en: a plant grown in large quantities for food or other uses
the amount of a plant harvested at one time
to remove outer parts of an image or cut hair short

ex.en: The farmer checked his wheat crop after the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨过后，农民查看了自己的小麦。

ex.en: Rising temperatures may reduce crop yields, threatening food security in regions that already experience water shortages.
ex.zh: 气温上升可能导致农作物减产，威胁本就缺水地区的粮食安全。

tip: crop既指庄稼也指收成；动词可指裁剪照片。

senses.en: to make someone admire or respect someone or something

senses.zh: 使铭记；使意识到重要性
senses.en: to make someone understand how important something is

ex.en: Her homemade bread impressed everyone at the family dinner.
ex.zh: 她自制的面包让家宴上的每个人都赞不绝口。

ex.en: Applicants can impress potential employers by explaining how their practical experience matches the requirements of the role.
ex.zh: 求职者可以说明自己的实践经验如何符合岗位要求，从而给潜在雇主留下好印象。

col: impress someone with｜以……给某人留下好印象
tip: impressed形容人的感受；impressive形容事物令人赞叹。

senses.en: To go somewhere and bring someone or something back.
To be sold for a particular amount of money.

ex.en: Could you fetch my jacket from the bedroom?
ex.zh: 你能去卧室把我的夹克拿来吗？

ex.en: Homes near reliable public transport often fetch higher prices because buyers value convenient access to employment.
ex.zh: 公共交通便利可靠的地段，住宅往往售价更高，因为买家重视通勤的便利性。

col: fetch someone from school｜去学校接某人
fetch a high price｜卖个高价
tip: fetch强调去后取回；bring只强调带来。

senses.en: A small item worn to show identity, membership, or achievement.

ex.en: She pinned her new badge onto her jacket.
ex.zh: 她把新徽章别在了夹克上。

ex.en: Requiring visitors to wear a visible badge can improve security in schools and other public buildings.
ex.zh: 要求访客佩戴醒目的身份徽章，有助于提高学校及其他公共建筑的安全性。

col: a badge of honour｜荣誉的象征
tip: 通常指佩戴的小徽章；奖牌一般用medal。

senses.en: To become ice or make something extremely cold and solid.
To stop something changing or being used temporarily.
To stop moving suddenly because of fear or surprise.

ex.en: Freeze the leftover soup and eat it next week.
ex.zh: 把剩下的汤冷冻起来，下周再喝。

ex.en: Governments may freeze public transport fares to reduce financial pressure on households during economic downturns.
ex.zh: 在经济低迷时期，政府可能会冻结公共交通票价，以减轻家庭的经济压力。

tip: 过去式froze，过去分词frozen。

senses.en: The authority or place checking goods entering a country
Taxes charged on goods brought into a country
Traditional practices shared by a community or social group

ex.en: We opened our suitcases for inspection at customs.
ex.zh: 我们在海关打开行李箱接受检查。

ex.en: More efficient customs procedures can reduce delays at borders and support international trade without weakening security.
ex.zh: 更高效的海关程序可以减少边境延误，在不削弱安全保障的情况下促进国际贸易。

tip: 表示海关时保留词尾s；custom单数不表示海关。

senses.en: A shop or hospital department that prepares and supplies medicines.
The study and practice of preparing and supplying medicines.

ex.en: I collected my medicine from the pharmacy after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，我去药店取了药。

ex.en: A community pharmacy can improve access to healthcare by offering professional advice close to people's homes.
ex.zh: 社区药店能在居民家附近提供专业建议，使医疗保健服务更易获得。

tip: 药店可数，药剂学不可数；药剂师是pharmacist。

senses.en: A man who is in charge of a school.

ex.en: The headmaster welcomed new pupils at the school gate.
ex.zh: 男校长在校门口迎接新生。

ex.en: The headmaster introduced a mentoring programme to help younger pupils develop confidence and settle into school life.
ex.zh: 男校长推行了一项辅导计划，帮助低年级学生建立信心并适应学校生活。

tip: 指男性；英式headteacher不分性别，美式常用principal。

senses.en: kind and concerned about other people's needs
the work of looking after people who need help

ex.en: Our caring neighbour brought soup when I was ill.
ex.zh: 我生病时，体贴的邻居送来了汤。

ex.en: A caring school environment can improve children's confidence and encourage them to seek help when needed.
ex.zh: 充满关怀的学校环境能增强孩子的信心，并鼓励他们在需要时寻求帮助。

col: a caring environment｜充满关怀的环境
tip: caring指关心别人；careful指做事小心。

senses.en: Finding a total by adding equal groups together.
An increase in quantity, often through repeated reproduction.

ex.en: We practised multiplication by arranging buttons in equal rows.
ex.zh: 我们把纽扣排成等长的几行来练习乘法。

ex.en: A strong understanding of multiplication helps children develop the mathematical skills needed for science and financial literacy.
ex.zh: 扎实理解乘法有助于儿童发展学习科学和掌握财务知识所需的数学技能。

col: rapid multiplication｜快速繁殖；迅速增加
tip: 乘法用multiplication；乘以可用multiplied by。

senses.en: To find someone or something unpleasant or not enjoyable.
A feeling of not liking someone or something.

ex.en: I dislike waiting outside when it is raining.
ex.zh: 我不喜欢下雨时在外面等候。

ex.en: Some students dislike group assignments because they feel that individual contributions are not assessed fairly.
ex.zh: 一些学生不喜欢小组作业，因为他们觉得个人贡献没有得到公平评价。

col: dislike doing something｜不喜欢做某事
a strong dislike of｜对……的强烈反感
take a dislike to｜开始讨厌
tip: dislike后接名词或动名词：dislike waiting。

senses.en: an educational talk given to an audience, especially university students
to give an educational talk to an audience
to criticize someone at length about their behaviour

ex.en: I stayed after the lecture to ask a question.
ex.zh: 讲座结束后，我留下来问了一个问题。

ex.en: Universities should combine traditional lectures with practical activities that encourage students to apply their knowledge.
ex.zh: 大学应将传统授课与鼓励学生运用知识的实践活动结合起来。

col: lecture someone about｜就某事训斥某人
tip: lecture on讲授某主题；lecture someone可指训斥。

senses.en: Food placed inside a pie, sandwich, or similar item.
Material used to repair a hole in a tooth.
Making you feel full after eating.

ex.en: This pie has a warm apple and cinnamon filling.
ex.zh: 这个派里面是热乎乎的苹果肉桂馅。

ex.en: School lunches should offer filling meals that provide sufficient nutrients to support children's growth and concentration.
ex.zh: 学校午餐应提供有饱腹感且营养充足的饭菜，以支持儿童成长并帮助他们集中注意力。

tip: 作形容词表示食物顶饱，不表示人已经吃饱。

senses.en: To respect someone for their qualities or achievements
To look at something with pleasure because it is attractive

ex.en: I admire my sister for staying calm under pressure.
ex.zh: 我钦佩姐姐在压力下依然保持冷静。

ex.en: People often admire successful athletes for their determination, but consistent training is equally important.
ex.zh: 人们常因成功运动员的毅力而钦佩他们，但坚持训练同样重要。

col: admire someone for something｜因某事钦佩某人
tip: admire sb for sth：因某事钦佩某人。

senses.en: The physical state of someone or something
A requirement, or circumstances affecting life or activity
A medical problem affecting someone's health

ex.en: Despite its age, this bicycle is in excellent condition.
ex.zh: 这辆自行车虽然年头已久，但状况极佳。

ex.en: Improving working conditions can increase employee satisfaction and reduce the number of people leaving their jobs.
ex.zh: 改善工作条件可以提高员工满意度，并减少离职人数。

tip: 表状态通常不可数；表工作、生活环境常用复数。

senses.en: not joined, shared, or considered together
to divide things or move them apart

ex.en: We keep clean towels in a separate cupboard.
ex.zh: 我们把干净毛巾放在一个单独的柜子里。

ex.en: Local authorities should provide separate bins for recyclable materials to make household waste sorting easier.
ex.zh: 地方政府应为可回收材料提供专用垃圾桶，让家庭垃圾分类更方便。

tip: 形容词词尾读/ət/，动词词尾读/eɪt/。

senses.en: not mixed with other substances
complete and containing nothing of a different kind
concerned with theory rather than practical uses

ex.en: This soft scarf is made from pure wool.
ex.zh: 这条柔软的围巾是纯羊毛制成的。

ex.en: Investment in pure science can lead to unexpected discoveries with important practical applications decades later.
ex.zh: 对纯理论科学的投资可能带来意想不到的发现，并在几十年后产生重要的实际应用。

tip: pure既可指无杂质，也可加强语气，如pure luck。

senses.en: Open your mouth widely and breathe deeply from tiredness or boredom.
An involuntary wide opening of the mouth with a deep breath.

ex.en: I yawned twice while waiting for the kettle to boil.
ex.zh: 等水壶里的水烧开时，我打了两次哈欠。

ex.en: Students who regularly yawn during morning lessons may not be getting enough sleep at night.
ex.zh: 经常在早课上打哈欠的学生，可能夜间睡眠不足。

tip: 打哈欠可说yawn或give a yawn。

senses.en: a small pepper with a strong, hot taste
a spicy dish usually made with meat, beans, and tomatoes

ex.en: Add one chopped chilli if you like spicy food.
ex.zh: 如果你喜欢吃辣，就加一根切碎的辣椒。

ex.en: Farmers growing chilli peppers may need reliable irrigation systems as rising temperatures increase water demand.
ex.zh: 随着气温上升导致需水量增加，辣椒种植户可能需要可靠的灌溉系统。

tip: 英式拼写chilli，美式通常写chili。

senses.en: Fully grown and ready to eat or harvest
Ready for a particular action or development

ex.en: These ripe peaches smell wonderful and taste very sweet.
ex.zh: 这些熟桃子闻起来很香，吃起来很甜。

ex.en: With public support growing, the time is ripe for governments to invest more in renewable energy.
ex.zh: 随着公众支持度上升，政府加大可再生能源投资的时机已经成熟。

col: ripe for change｜变革时机成熟的
the time is ripe｜时机已经成熟
tip: 水果成熟用ripe；人心智成熟通常用mature。

senses.en: having a strong, unpleasant smell

ex.en: Please leave those stinky shoes outside the front door.
ex.zh: 请把那些臭鞋放在前门外。

ex.en: Residents often describe neglected rubbish bins as stinky, highlighting how poor waste collection affects daily life.
ex.zh: 居民常说无人清理的垃圾桶臭气熏天，这凸显了垃圾清运不力对日常生活的影响。

tip: 非正式用语；正式写作可用foul-smelling。

senses.en: Having a natural ability to do something very well.

ex.en: My talented cousin painted this beautiful picture of our garden.
ex.zh: 我那位有绘画天赋的表亲画了这幅漂亮的花园图。

ex.en: Schools should provide opportunities for talented students to develop their abilities beyond the standard curriculum.
ex.zh: 学校应为有才华的学生提供机会，让他们在标准课程之外发展自己的能力。

col: a talented musician｜有天赋的音乐家
a talented artist｜有才华的艺术家
tip: talented强调天赋；skilled强调熟练技能。

senses.en: unhappy because someone has something you want

senses.zh: 因担心失去爱而吃醋的
senses.en: upset because someone you love shows interest in another person

ex.en: I felt jealous when my cousin got a bicycle.
ex.zh: 表弟得到一辆自行车时，我心里很嫉妒。

ex.en: Social media can make users jealous of others whose lives appear more successful or exciting.
ex.zh: 社交媒体可能让用户嫉妒那些生活看起来更成功或更精彩的人。

col: a jealous partner｜爱吃醋的伴侣
tip: 常用be jealous of；既可指嫉妒，也可指吃醋。

senses.en: an edible seed that grows underground inside a thin shell
a very small amount of money, expressed as peanuts

ex.en: She cracked the shell and ate the peanut inside.
ex.zh: 她剥开壳，吃掉了里面的花生米。

ex.en: Schools should consider peanut allergies when planning meals to ensure that all children can eat safely.
ex.zh: 学校安排膳食时应考虑花生过敏问题，确保所有儿童都能安全用餐。

col: work for peanuts｜为微薄报酬工作
tip: 表示“极少的钱”时用复数peanuts，属非正式用法。

senses.en: Relating to laws or the system that applies them
Allowed by the law

ex.en: We sought legal advice before signing the rental agreement.
ex.zh: 签订租赁协议前，我们征求了法律意见。

ex.en: Access to affordable legal services is essential for ensuring that disadvantaged citizens can defend their rights.
ex.zh: 让人们获得负担得起的法律服务，对保障弱势公民维护自身权利至关重要。

tip: legal可指“法律相关的”，不一定指“合法的”。

senses.en: A set of tools or equipment for a particular activity
A set of parts used to build something

ex.en: We keep a first aid kit in the car.
ex.zh: 我们在车里备有一个急救包。

ex.en: Schools should provide basic science kits so that all pupils can take part in practical experiments.
ex.zh: 学校应提供基础科学实验套件，让所有学生都能参与动手实验。

col: kit someone out｜给某人配齐装备
tip: kit指成套用品；kit sb out表示给某人配装备。

senses.en: At or to a greater distance.
Located at a greater distance.

ex.en: We walked farther along the beach before stopping for lunch.
ex.zh: 我们沿海滩又走了一段路才停下来吃午饭。

ex.en: As housing costs rise, many workers move farther from city centres and face longer daily commutes.
ex.zh: 随着住房成本上涨，许多上班族搬到离市中心更远的地方，每天通勤时间也随之增加。

tip: farther多指实际距离；进一步讨论用further。

senses.en: a woman who rents property or rooms to other people
a woman who owns or manages a pub

ex.en: Our landlady came round to fix the kitchen tap.
ex.zh: 我们的女房东过来修厨房水龙头。

ex.en: A responsible landlady should maintain safe housing conditions and respond promptly when tenants report serious problems.
ex.zh: 负责任的女房东应确保住房条件安全，并在租客报告严重问题时及时回应。

col: pay rent to the landlady｜向女房东交租
tip: landlady指女性；landlord可泛指房东。

senses.en: A woman who welcomes and entertains guests.
A woman who welcomes customers and takes them to restaurant tables.

ex.en: Our hostess brought out fresh fruit after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐后，女主人端来了新鲜水果。

ex.en: A welcoming hostess can help international visitors feel comfortable and encourage meaningful conversations across cultures.
ex.zh: 热情的女主人能让国际访客感到自在，并促进有意义的跨文化交流。

col: a gracious hostess｜亲切周到的女主人
the perfect hostess｜无可挑剔的女主人
tip: hostess特指女性；host如今也可用于任何性别。

senses.en: relaxed and not easily upset or worried

ex.en: Our easy-going neighbour never complains when our dog barks.
ex.zh: 我们随和的邻居从不因我们的狗叫而抱怨。

ex.en: Although an easy-going management style can reduce workplace stress, clear expectations remain essential for maintaining productivity.
ex.zh: 虽然随和的管理风格能减轻职场压力，但明确的要求对保持生产力仍然至关重要。

tip: 形容性格随和、不易生气，不表示懒惰。

senses.en: Not speaking or choosing not to speak.
Making no sound or containing no noise.
Written in a word but not pronounced.

ex.en: He remained silent while his sister explained the problem.
ex.zh: 妹妹解释问题时，他一直没有说话。

ex.en: Employees may remain silent about workplace problems if they fear losing their jobs.
ex.zh: 如果员工担心失去工作，就可能对职场问题保持沉默。

tip: silent强调不出声；quiet也可表示声音很小。

senses.en: extremely large in size, amount, or degree

ex.en: An enormous pumpkin filled the basket on our kitchen table.
ex.zh: 一个巨大的南瓜占满了厨房桌上的篮子。

ex.en: Rapid urban growth places enormous pressure on housing, transport networks, and other essential public services.
ex.zh: 城市的快速发展给住房、交通网络及其他基本公共服务带来巨大压力。

tip: 既可形容体积，也可形容压力、数量或影响很大。

senses.en: A plan or preparation for something that will happen.
The way objects are positioned or organised.
An agreement about how something will be done.

ex.en: We made arrangements for someone to feed the cat.
ex.zh: 我们安排了人来喂猫。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help parents balance professional responsibilities with the demands of family life.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排可以帮助父母兼顾工作职责与家庭生活的需要。

col: come to an arrangement｜达成协议
tip: 表示具体筹备常用复数：make arrangements for。

senses.en: A particular way of doing something, often requiring skill.
The skill someone shows when performing a particular activity.

ex.en: The coach showed me a better technique for swimming.
ex.zh: 教练向我示范了一种更好的游泳技巧。

ex.en: Teachers can use a range of assessment techniques to identify learning difficulties before students fall behind.
ex.zh: 教师可以运用多种评估方法，在学生落后之前发现他们的学习困难。

col: a technique for doing something｜做某事的方法
tip: technique重在具体方法；technology指科技。

senses.en: to put something down carefully or arrange it flat
to produce eggs from the body
not professionally trained in a subject or ordained in religion

ex.en: Please lay the clean towels on the bathroom shelf.
ex.zh: 请把干净毛巾放在浴室架子上。

ex.en: Investment in early childhood education can lay the foundations for a more skilled and adaptable workforce.
ex.zh: 投资幼儿教育可以为培养技能更强、适应力更高的劳动力奠定基础。

tip: 放置用lay–laid–laid；躺下用lie–lay–lain。

senses.en: A remark expressing admiration or approval.
To tell someone that you admire something about them.

ex.en: Her compliment about my cooking made me smile.
ex.zh: 她对我厨艺的称赞让我笑了。

ex.en: Teachers who compliment students on specific improvements can strengthen motivation and encourage continued effort.
ex.zh: 教师若针对学生的具体进步给予表扬，就能增强学习动力，鼓励他们继续努力。

col: pay someone a compliment｜称赞某人
compliment someone on something｜称赞某人的某方面
tip: compliment是赞美；complement是补充、相辅相成。

senses.en: Money returned after a purchase or an overpayment.
To return money paid for something.

ex.en: The shop gave me a refund for the broken kettle.
ex.zh: 商店把坏水壶的货款退给了我。

ex.en: Airlines should offer passengers a full refund when flights are cancelled without reasonable alternatives.
ex.zh: 航班取消且没有合理的替代方案时，航空公司应向乘客提供全额退款。

tip: 名词重音在前；动词读/rɪˈfʌnd/，重音在后。

senses.en: A sport involving controlled movements that develop strength, balance, and flexibility.

ex.en: My sister practises gymnastics at the local sports centre.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在当地体育中心练体操。

ex.en: Including gymnastics in school programmes can help children develop coordination, physical confidence, and an interest in exercise.
ex.zh: 将体操纳入学校课程有助于儿童提高协调性、增强身体自信，并培养运动兴趣。

tip: 虽以-s结尾，表示运动时作单数：gymnastics is。

senses.en: The ability or authority to control people, events, or decisions.
Energy used to make machines and equipment work.
To supply energy that makes something work.

ex.en: The manager has the power to change our shifts.
ex.zh: 经理有权调整我们的班次。

ex.en: Solar panels can power rural schools while reducing their dependence on expensive and unreliable fuel supplies.
ex.zh: 太阳能板可以为乡村学校供电，同时减少其对昂贵且不稳定的燃料供应的依赖。

tip: 表示有权做某事用have the power to do。

senses.en: An online audio programme available to stream or download.
To produce and distribute an online audio programme.

ex.en: I listen to a cooking podcast while making dinner.
ex.zh: 我做晚饭时会听一档烹饪播客。

ex.en: Educational podcasts allow learners to explore complex subjects while travelling or completing routine household tasks.
ex.zh: 教育类播客让学习者能够在出行或做日常家务时探索复杂的主题。

col: listen to a podcast｜收听播客
host a podcast｜主持播客节目
subscribe to a podcast｜订阅播客
tip: 收听播客用listen to a podcast，别漏掉to。

senses.en: To a great degree or in large amounts.
With great weight, force, or effort.

ex.en: It rained heavily while we waited for the bus.
ex.zh: 我们等公交车时，雨下得很大。

ex.en: Countries that rely heavily on imported fuel are particularly vulnerable to sudden changes in global energy prices.
ex.zh: 严重依赖进口燃料的国家尤其容易受到全球能源价格突变的影响。

tip: 表示下大雨用rain heavily，不用rain strongly。

senses.en: A large container for holding liquids or gases.
A heavily protected military vehicle that moves on tracks.

ex.en: The fish swam behind a rock in the tank.
ex.zh: 鱼游到了水族箱里的一块石头后面。

ex.en: Installing a rainwater tank allows households to water gardens without relying entirely on treated drinking water.
ex.zh: 安装雨水储水箱能让家庭浇灌花园时不必完全依赖经过处理的饮用水。

tip: fish tank是水族箱；汽车的油箱用fuel tank。

senses.en: to understand someone's words, actions, or intentions incorrectly

ex.en: Please don't misunderstand me; I really want to help.
ex.zh: 请别误会我，我真的想帮忙。

ex.en: Patients may misunderstand medical advice when professionals use technical language rather than clear explanations suited to their audience.
ex.zh: 如果医务人员使用专业术语，而不是适合患者理解的清晰解释，患者可能会误解医嘱。

col: misunderstand someone's intentions｜误会某人的意图
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为misunderstood。

senses.en: Related to the simplest or first stages of learning.
Relating to the first years of formal school education.

ex.en: This course teaches elementary cooking skills to complete beginners.
ex.zh: 这门课程向零基础学员教授基本烹饪技巧。

ex.en: Elementary education should develop children's curiosity as well as their ability to read and calculate.
ex.zh: 小学教育不仅应培养儿童的阅读和计算能力，还应激发他们的好奇心。

tip: elementary school主要用于美式英语，英式常用primary school。

senses.en: In, from, or relating to the west of an area.
Relating to Europe, North America, and their associated cultures.
A film or story about the historical American West.

ex.en: Our cabin faces the lake on its western shore.
ex.zh: 我们的小屋位于湖的西岸，面朝湖水。

ex.en: Investment in western regions could improve transport links and reduce economic inequalities within the country.
ex.zh: 对西部地区的投资可以改善交通联系，减少国内经济差距。

tip: 指西方国家或文化时常大写为 Western。

senses.en: An area with a particular purpose, feature, or condition.
Officially assign land to a particular use.

ex.en: Cars are not allowed inside this quiet pedestrian zone.
ex.zh: 汽车不得驶入这片安静的步行区。

ex.en: Creating a low-emission zone can reduce air pollution, provided that affordable public transport is available.
ex.zh: 只要有价格合理的公共交通，设立低排放区就能减少空气污染。

col: zone land for housing｜将土地划为住宅用地
tip: zone强调特定用途或特征的区域；area含义更宽泛。

senses.en: A strong metal used in construction and needed by the body.
A tool with a heated base for smoothing clothes.
To make clothes smooth using a heated iron.

ex.en: These old iron gates are too heavy to lift.
ex.zh: 这些旧铁门太重，抬不起来。

ex.en: A diet containing sufficient iron can help prevent anaemia, particularly among children and pregnant women.
ex.zh: 摄入足量铁的饮食有助于预防贫血，对儿童和孕妇尤其重要。

tip: 铁是不可数名词；熨斗可数，用an iron。

senses.en: an act of changing position or moving the body
an organised effort by people seeking shared social change
one main section of a long piece of music

ex.en: A sudden movement in the bushes caught my attention.
ex.zh: 灌木丛里突然有动静，引起了我的注意。

ex.en: The environmental movement has encouraged governments to adopt stronger policies on waste reduction and renewable energy.
ex.zh: 环保运动推动各国政府在减少废物和发展可再生能源方面采取更有力的政策。

tip: 指具体动作或社会运动时可数；泛指移动可不可数。

senses.en: containing different types of things or people
including both positive and negative feelings, opinions, or results

ex.en: I bought a bag of mixed nuts for our picnic.
ex.zh: 我买了一袋混合坚果，准备野餐时吃。

ex.en: The introduction of online lessons received mixed reactions from students, parents, and teachers.
ex.zh: 学生、家长和教师对引入网课的反应褒贬不一。

tip: mixed feelings指心情矛盾；mixed也是mix的过去分词。

senses.en: A liquid measure of about half a litre.

ex.en: Please add a pint of milk to the bowl.
ex.zh: 请往碗里加入一品脱牛奶。

ex.en: Consumers comparing international recipes should note that a British pint is larger than an American pint.
ex.zh: 比较不同国家食谱的消费者应注意，英制品脱比美制品脱大。

col: a pint of milk｜一品脱牛奶
tip: 英制品脱约568毫升，美制液量品脱约473毫升。

senses.en: separated by distance or time; not together
into separate pieces
except for something being considered

ex.en: We planted the young trees two metres apart.
ex.zh: 我们把这些小树间隔两米种下。

ex.en: Living apart from their families can make international students more independent, but may also cause loneliness.
ex.zh: 与家人分开生活可以让留学生更加独立，但也可能带来孤独感。

tip: apart from可指“除外”或“除……还”，需看语境。

senses.en: Someone with extensive knowledge or skill in a particular subject.
Having or showing great knowledge or skill.

ex.en: We asked an expert to examine the old painting.
ex.zh: 我们请了一位专家来鉴定这幅旧画。

ex.en: Schools should seek expert advice before introducing new technology into classrooms to support student learning.
ex.zh: 学校在将新技术引入课堂以辅助学生学习之前，应征求专家意见。

col: an expert on｜某方面的专家
tip: expert on/in表示某领域的专家。

senses.en: similar in appearance or character
in the same way, or equally for both groups

ex.en: These two jackets look alike, but one feels warmer.
ex.zh: 这两件夹克看起来很像，但有一件穿着更暖和。

ex.en: Public parks benefit children and adults alike by providing accessible spaces for exercise and relaxation.
ex.zh: 公共公园提供方便使用的运动和休闲空间，让儿童和成人同样受益。

tip: 形容词通常放在系动词后，不放在名词前。

senses.en: A special event held to mark a happy occasion.
The act of showing happiness about something special.

ex.en: We decorated the garden for our grandparents' anniversary celebration.
ex.zh: 我们为祖父母的结婚周年庆祝活动布置了花园。

ex.en: Community celebrations can strengthen social bonds by bringing together residents from different cultural backgrounds.
ex.zh: 社区庆祝活动能让不同文化背景的居民相聚，从而加强社会联系。

col: hold a celebration｜举办庆祝活动
tip: 指具体庆祝活动时可数；指庆祝行为时不可数。

senses.en: A flat shape with three straight sides and three angles.
A triangular metal musical instrument struck with a small metal stick.

ex.en: Fold the paper into a triangle before cutting it.
ex.zh: 先把纸折成三角形，再剪。

ex.en: Engineers often use triangles in bridge designs because these shapes provide strength without requiring excessive material.
ex.zh: 工程师常在桥梁设计中采用三角形，因为这种形状无需耗用过多材料就能提供强度。

tip: 英式说right-angled triangle，美式常说right triangle。

senses.en: A sour liquid used to flavour or preserve food.

ex.en: Add a little vinegar to the salad dressing.
ex.zh: 往沙拉酱里加一点醋。

ex.en: Traditional food preservation methods often use vinegar to slow bacterial growth and extend the storage life of vegetables.
ex.zh: 传统食品保存方法常用醋来减缓细菌生长，延长蔬菜的储存时间。

tip: 通常不可数，表示数量可用a bottle of vinegar。

senses.en: a visual display of information, often showing comparisons or changes
to record or show how something develops over time
a detailed map used for navigation at sea or in air

ex.en: This colourful chart shows how we spend our money.
ex.zh: 这张彩色图表展示了我们把钱花在了哪些方面。

ex.en: The chart compares the proportion of commuters using public transport in three different cities.
ex.zh: 该图表比较了三个不同城市中使用公共交通的通勤者比例。

tip: 图表用chart；普通地图用map，海图可用chart。

senses.en: Unpleasantly cold, though usually not extremely cold.
Showing little warmth or friendliness towards someone.

ex.en: It felt chilly outside, so I grabbed my jacket.
ex.zh: 外面有些冷，所以我拿上了夹克。

ex.en: Providing warm public spaces during chilly weather can help protect older residents from cold-related illnesses.
ex.zh: 在寒冷天气提供温暖的公共场所，有助于保护老年居民免受寒冷引发的疾病侵害。

tip: chilly比freezing程度轻，也可形容态度冷淡。

senses.en: A natural ability to do something well.
People who have strong abilities in a particular field.

ex.en: My cousin has a real talent for drawing animals.
ex.zh: 我的表亲画动物很有天赋。

ex.en: Schools should nurture creative talent alongside academic skills to help students develop a wider range of abilities.
ex.zh: 学校应在培养学业技能的同时培育创造性才能，帮助学生发展更广泛的能力。

col: a talent for｜在某方面的天赋
tip: 表示某方面的天赋，用a talent for加名词或动名词。

senses.en: move back up after hitting a surface, or cause this
a movement back up after hitting a surface
be rejected by a bank because funds are insufficient

ex.en: The ball bounced over the fence into our neighbour's garden.
ex.zh: 球弹过篱笆，落进了邻居的花园。

ex.en: Local businesses can bounce back after economic shocks if they receive timely financial support.
ex.zh: 如果及时获得资金支持，当地企业就能在经济冲击后恢复元气。

col: bounce ideas off someone｜与某人交流想法
tip: bounce back既可指弹回，也常指受挫后恢复。

senses.en: Rest or enjoyable activity that reduces stress and tension.
The process of muscles becoming less tight.
The act of making rules or restrictions less strict.

ex.en: After work, I enjoy a warm bath for relaxation.
ex.zh: 下班后，我喜欢泡个热水澡放松一下。

ex.en: Schools should teach relaxation techniques to help students manage anxiety before important examinations.
ex.zh: 学校应教授放松技巧，帮助学生缓解重要考试前的焦虑。

tip: 表示放松、休息时通常不可数：for relaxation。

senses.en: a large sea fish, or its flesh eaten as food

ex.en: I made a tuna sandwich for lunch today.
ex.zh: 我今天做了一个金枪鱼三明治当午餐。

ex.en: International cooperation is essential to prevent overfishing and ensure that tuna populations remain healthy for future generations.
ex.zh: 国际合作对于防止过度捕捞、确保金枪鱼种群为后代保持健康至关重要。

tip: 指鱼肉时不可数；指鱼时复数通常仍为tuna。

senses.en: The act of reaching the ground or shore.
A flat area at the top of or between stairs.

ex.en: The plane made a smooth landing despite the wind.
ex.zh: 尽管有风，飞机还是平稳着陆了。

ex.en: Improved weather forecasting can help pilots prepare for a safe landing during rapidly changing conditions.
ex.zh: 更准确的天气预报能帮助飞行员在天气快速变化时做好安全着陆的准备。

tip: 除“着陆”外，也指楼梯顶部或中间的平台。

senses.en: Attractive and fashionable in appearance or design

ex.en: Her stylish green jacket looked great with plain trousers.
ex.zh: 她那件时髦的绿色夹克搭配素色长裤很好看。

ex.en: Affordable, stylish furniture can encourage young consumers to choose recycled materials for their homes.
ex.zh: 价格实惠且设计时尚的家具，可以鼓励年轻消费者为家中选用再生材料。

col: a stylish design｜有格调的设计
a stylish interior｜雅致的室内空间
tip: stylish强调时尚美观；不等于昂贵或奢华。

senses.en: relating to a whole country or its people
a person who is a citizen of a particular country

ex.en: My sister hopes to join the national swimming team.
ex.zh: 我姐姐希望加入国家游泳队。

ex.en: National policies can help reduce regional differences in access to healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 国家政策有助于缩小医疗和教育机会方面的地区差异。

tip: national侧重一国整体；international指国际的。

senses.en: A wind instrument held sideways and played by blowing across it.

ex.en: She practises the flute by her bedroom window every afternoon.
ex.zh: 她每天下午都在卧室窗边练习长笛。

ex.en: Learning to play the flute can develop concentration and encourage children to participate in musical ensembles.
ex.zh: 学习吹长笛可以培养专注力，并鼓励儿童参加合奏团体。

tip: 英式常称演奏者为flautist，美式常用flutist。

senses.en: the inside surface at the top of a room
the highest amount or level that is allowed

ex.en: A small spider was crawling across the ceiling.
ex.zh: 一只小蜘蛛正爬过天花板。

ex.en: A ceiling on annual rent increases could protect tenants, although it might discourage investment in housing.
ex.zh: 限制年度租金涨幅可以保护租户，但也可能抑制住房投资。

col: set a ceiling on｜为……设定上限
tip: ceiling是室内天花板；roof是建筑外部的屋顶。

senses.en: quiet and calm, without disturbance or worry
not involving war, violence, or fighting

ex.en: The lake looks peaceful in the early morning light.
ex.zh: 晨光中的湖泊显得格外宁静。

ex.en: Creating peaceful public spaces can improve residents' wellbeing and encourage more people to spend time outdoors.
ex.zh: 营造宁静的公共空间可以提升居民的幸福感，并鼓励更多人到户外活动。

tip: 可形容环境安静，也可指行动不使用暴力。

senses.en: The ability to form mental pictures or invent new ideas.

ex.en: With a little imagination, this box becomes a spaceship.
ex.zh: 只需一点想象力，这个盒子就能变成宇宙飞船。

ex.en: Creative activities encourage children to use their imagination and approach unfamiliar problems from different perspectives.
ex.zh: 创意活动鼓励儿童运用想象力，从不同角度处理陌生的问题。

col: a figment of the imagination｜凭空想象的事物
tip: imaginative指有想象力的；imaginary指想象中的。

senses.en: not kind or welcoming towards others
making an activity difficult or causing harm

ex.en: The new neighbour seemed unfriendly but was simply shy.
ex.zh: 新邻居看似冷淡，其实只是害羞。

ex.en: An unfriendly working environment can discourage employees from sharing ideas and seeking support.
ex.zh: 不友好的工作环境可能使员工不愿分享想法或寻求支持。

tip: 虽以-ly结尾，但通常是形容词，不是副词。

senses.en: The loud sound in the sky caused by lightning
Produce thunder or make a similarly loud, deep noise

ex.en: A sudden clap of thunder made the windows shake.
ex.zh: 一声突如其来的雷鸣震得窗户直晃。

ex.en: Outdoor sports events should be suspended when thunder indicates that a storm is dangerously close.
ex.zh: 当雷声表明雷暴已逼近到危险距离时，应暂停户外体育赛事。

col: a clap of thunder｜一声雷响
a rumble of thunder｜低沉的隆隆雷声
tip: thunder指雷声，通常不可数；lightning指闪电。

senses.en: A difficult task or situation that tests someone's abilities.
Question whether something is true, fair, or acceptable.
Invite someone to compete or test their abilities.

ex.en: Cooking dinner for twelve guests was quite a challenge.
ex.zh: 给十二位客人做晚饭真是个不小的挑战。

ex.en: Providing affordable housing remains a major challenge for cities experiencing rapid population growth and rising land prices.
ex.zh: 对于人口快速增长、地价不断上涨的城市而言，提供可负担住房仍是一项重大挑战。

col: meet a challenge｜成功应对挑战
challenge someone to a contest｜向某人发起比赛挑战
tip: challenge作动词可直接接观点，表示质疑。

senses.en: A small cup with a handle, used for drinking tea.

ex.en: She placed a delicate teacup beside the biscuit plate.
ex.zh: 她把一只精致的茶杯放在饼干盘旁。

ex.en: A museum display of decorated teacups can reveal how domestic tastes and manufacturing techniques changed over time.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出的装饰茶杯可以揭示家居审美和制造技术如何随时间变化。

col: a teacup and saucer｜茶杯和茶托
a storm in a teacup｜小题大做
tip: teacup是茶杯；a cup of tea是一杯茶。

senses.en: to transfer files from a device to an online system
the transfer of a file online, or the file itself

ex.en: I uploaded our picnic photos to a shared folder.
ex.zh: 我把我们野餐的照片上传到了共享文件夹。

ex.en: Students can upload their assignments to a secure platform, allowing teachers to provide timely feedback.
ex.zh: 学生可以将作业上传至安全平台，方便教师及时提供反馈。

col: upload to a server｜上传至服务器
tip: 上传用upload，下载用download；上传至某处用to。

senses.en: A small piece of soft paper used for wiping.
A group of similar cells performing a particular bodily function.

ex.en: She handed me a tissue when I sneezed.
ex.zh: 我打喷嚏时，她递给我一张纸巾。

ex.en: Scientists are developing new treatments that help damaged tissue recover more effectively after an injury.
ex.zh: 科学家正在开发新疗法，帮助受损组织在受伤后更有效地修复。

col: a box of tissues｜一盒纸巾
tip: 纸巾是可数名词；生物组织通常不可数。

senses.en: something said or written to express information or an opinion
a formal public announcement about a particular matter
a record showing financial transactions over a period

ex.en: Her statement about the broken window surprised everyone.
ex.zh: 她关于那扇破窗的说法让所有人都很惊讶。

ex.en: The council issued a statement explaining how the proposed transport scheme would benefit residents with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 市议会发表声明，解释拟议的交通方案将如何惠及行动不便的居民。

tip: 作“陈述”时是可数名词；银行对账单也用statement。

senses.en: A woman who is getting married or has just married.

ex.en: The bride held fresh flowers as she entered the garden.
ex.zh: 新娘手捧鲜花走进花园。

ex.en: In many cultures, the bride and her family share responsibility for organising the wedding celebration.
ex.zh: 在许多文化中，新娘及其家人共同负责筹办婚礼庆典。

tip: bride指新娘，groom指新郎。

senses.en: unable to understand something or think clearly
unclear or difficult to follow because of poor organisation

ex.en: I felt confused when both doors led outside.
ex.zh: 两扇门都通向外面，让我感到困惑。

ex.en: Students may become confused if teachers introduce too many unfamiliar concepts in a single lesson.
ex.zh: 如果教师在一堂课中引入太多陌生概念，学生可能会感到困惑。

tip: confused形容人困惑；confusing形容事物令人困惑。

senses.en: Not often; on very few occasions.

ex.en: We rarely eat outside when the weather turns cold.
ex.zh: 天气转冷时，我们很少在户外吃饭。

ex.en: People living in remote villages rarely have easy access to specialist medical services.
ex.zh: 住在偏远村庄的人很少能方便地获得专科医疗服务。

tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；本身有否定意味。

senses.en: An arrangement to keep a room, seat, or table available.
A doubt that prevents complete acceptance of something.

ex.en: I made a reservation for dinner by the window.
ex.zh: 我预订了一个靠窗的位置吃晚饭。

ex.en: Some residents expressed reservations about the proposed airport expansion because of increased noise pollution.
ex.zh: 一些居民担心噪声污染加剧，对拟议中的机场扩建持保留意见。

tip: 表示疑虑常用复数：have reservations about。

senses.en: The smallest amount or level possible or allowed.
Being the smallest amount or level possible or allowed.

ex.en: Please keep the noise to a minimum tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚请尽量保持安静。

ex.en: A higher minimum wage may improve living standards for workers in low-paid service jobs.
ex.zh: 提高最低工资可能改善低薪服务业劳动者的生活水平。

col: keep something to a minimum｜将某事物减至最低程度
tip: a minimum of 后接数量，表示“至少”。

senses.en: a public statement giving people information or news

ex.en: We heard an announcement about our train being delayed.
ex.zh: 我们听到了一则关于所乘列车晚点的通知。

ex.en: The government's announcement of additional education funding was welcomed by teachers and parents.
ex.zh: 政府宣布追加教育经费，受到教师和家长的欢迎。

tip: 表示发布公告时用make an announcement。

senses.en: A body part or aircraft structure that enables flight.
A section extending from the main part of a building.
A group within an organisation sharing particular views or aims.

ex.en: The bird stretched its wings before leaving the branch.
ex.zh: 那只鸟飞离树枝前展开了翅膀。

ex.en: The hospital's new wing will provide additional beds and specialist facilities for the region's growing population.
ex.zh: 医院新建的侧楼将提供更多床位和专科设施，以服务该地区不断增长的人口。

col: spread your wings｜展开翅膀；拓展自我
tip: 鸟的翅膀和飞机机翼都用wing，通常成对用复数。

senses.en: A hard pointed growth on the head of some animals.
A device on a vehicle that makes a loud warning sound.
A musical instrument played by blowing into a tube.

ex.en: The goat caught its horn in the fence.
ex.zh: 那只山羊的角卡在了栅栏里。

ex.en: Frequent use of car horns contributes to noise pollution and reduces residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 频繁使用汽车喇叭会造成噪声污染，降低居民的生活质量。

tip: 动物的角和车辆喇叭都用horn，均为可数名词。

senses.en: an artificial waterway for boats or carrying water
a narrow passage inside the body

ex.en: We watched a narrow boat glide along the canal.
ex.zh: 我们看着一艘窄船沿运河缓缓驶过。

ex.en: Restoring historic canals can attract tourists while providing valuable habitats for wildlife in densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 修复历史悠久的运河既能吸引游客，也能为人口密集城区的野生动物提供宝贵的栖息地。

tip: canal通常为人工水道；river指天然河流。

senses.en: Animals and other living things in their natural surroundings.

ex.en: We watched the wildlife quietly from behind the trees.
ex.zh: 我们躲在树后，静静地观察野生动物。

ex.en: Protecting wildlife requires governments to preserve natural habitats and limit development in environmentally sensitive areas.
ex.zh: 保护野生生物需要政府维护自然栖息地，并限制生态敏感地区的开发。

col: a wildlife reserve｜野生生物保护区
tip: 不可数名词；wildlife park中作名词定语。

senses.en: The upper front part of the body, enclosing heart and lungs.
A large strong box with a lid, used for storage.

ex.en: She held the sleeping kitten gently against her chest.
ex.zh: 她把熟睡的小猫轻轻抱在胸前。

ex.en: Workers exposed to polluted air may develop chest problems, highlighting the importance of effective workplace ventilation.
ex.zh: 接触污染空气的工人可能出现胸部疾病，这凸显了工作场所有效通风的重要性。

tip: chest指胸部或大箱子；chest of drawers才是抽屉柜。

senses.en: Through natural processes rather than human action
As would normally be expected
Because of qualities someone or something has from birth

ex.en: Let your hair dry naturally after you wash it.
ex.zh: 洗完头后，让头发自然晾干。

ex.en: Some pollutants occur naturally in the environment, but human activities can increase their concentration to harmful levels.
ex.zh: 某些污染物天然存在于环境中，但人类活动会使其浓度上升到有害水平。

col: come naturally to someone｜对某人来说轻而易举
tip: 句首Naturally常表示“当然”，不一定指天然。

senses.en: almost not, or only to a very small degree
only just, before something else happens

ex.en: I could hardly hear you over the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 雨声太大，我几乎听不见你说话。

ex.en: Expanding roads alone is hardly sufficient to solve traffic congestion without improvements to public transport.
ex.zh: 如果不改善公共交通，仅靠拓宽道路几乎不足以解决交通拥堵。

tip: hardly意为几乎不，并非hard的副词形式。

senses.en: the state of being protected from danger or harm

ex.en: Please wear a helmet for your own safety.
ex.zh: 为了你自身的安全，请戴上头盔。

ex.en: Improving road safety requires better street design as well as stricter enforcement of traffic laws.
ex.zh: 改善道路安全既需要更好的街道设计，也需要更严格地执行交通法规。

col: for safety reasons｜出于安全考虑
tip: 通常不可数；safe是形容词，safety是名词。

senses.en: A small house, usually in the countryside.

ex.en: Their cottage has a tiny garden full of roses.
ex.zh: 他们的乡间小屋有一个种满玫瑰的小花园。

ex.en: Converting an unused cottage into holiday accommodation can provide rural families with an additional source of income.
ex.zh: 将闲置的村舍改为度假住宿，可以为农村家庭增加一项收入来源。

tip: 通常指乡间小住宅，不等同于豪华的villa。

senses.en: having a liking or affection for someone or something
showing or expressing warmth and affection

ex.en: My grandmother is fond of walking by the river.
ex.zh: 我奶奶喜欢在河边散步。

ex.en: Many adults retain fond memories of teachers who encouraged their curiosity and supported their ambitions.
ex.zh: 许多成年人仍深情地记得那些激发他们好奇心、支持他们志向的老师。

tip: be fond of后接名词或动词-ing，不接to do。

senses.en: A public display of art, objects, or products.

ex.en: We visited a photography exhibition at the local museum.
ex.zh: 我们参观了当地博物馆的一场摄影展。

ex.en: An interactive exhibition can make scientific discoveries more accessible to children and encourage their interest in research.
ex.zh: 互动展览能让儿童更容易理解科学发现，并激发他们对研究的兴趣。

tip: exhibition指整场展览；exhibit可指一件展品。

senses.en: The state of being hard to do or understand.
A problem that makes progress or success harder.

ex.en: I had difficulty opening the jar with wet hands.
ex.zh: 我手湿着，很难打开那个罐子。

ex.en: Students with limited internet access may have difficulty completing assignments that require extensive online research.
ex.zh: 网络使用受限的学生可能难以完成需要大量网上研究的作业。

col: have difficulty doing something｜做某事有困难
tip: 用have difficulty doing，不用difficulty to do。

senses.en: The gas water becomes when heated, often seen as white mist.
To cook food using steam from boiling water.

ex.en: Steam rose from the soup as I lifted the lid.
ex.zh: 我揭开盖子时，汤里升起了热气。

ex.en: Some power stations use heat to produce steam, which drives turbines and generates electricity.
ex.zh: 一些发电站利用热量产生蒸汽，推动涡轮机发电。

col: run out of steam｜耗尽精力
tip: steam作名词通常不可数；作动词可表示蒸食物。

senses.en: a strong feeling of fear, shock, or disgust
a type of fiction intended to frighten its audience

ex.en: She watched in horror as her laptop fell downstairs.
ex.zh: 她惊恐地看着自己的笔记本电脑掉下楼梯。

ex.en: Horror films often use music and lighting to create tension rather than relying entirely on frightening images.
ex.zh: 恐怖电影常用音乐和灯光制造紧张气氛，而非完全依赖吓人的画面。

tip: 情绪义通常不可数；in horror表示惊恐地。

senses.en: a written account of someone's life by another person

ex.en: I'm reading a biography of an explorer before bed.
ex.zh: 我睡前正在读一本探险家的传记。

ex.en: A well-researched biography can reveal how social conditions influence an individual's choices and achievements.
ex.zh: 一本研究扎实的传记可以揭示社会条件如何影响个人的选择与成就。

col: a biography of someone｜某人的传记
an authorised biography｜经本人授权的传记
tip: biography是他人为某人写的传记；自传用autobiography。

senses.en: to risk money on the result of an uncertain event
to say confidently that something is true or will happen
an agreement to risk money on an uncertain result

ex.en: I bet you left your keys in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我敢说你把钥匙落在厨房了。

ex.en: Some investors bet on emerging technologies despite considerable uncertainty about their future commercial success.
ex.zh: 一些投资者押注新兴技术，尽管这些技术未来能否取得商业成功仍很不确定。

tip: 过去式和过去分词通常仍是bet；I bet常表确信。

senses.en: A place where something is built, happens, or once existed.
A collection of connected web pages.
Place or build something in a particular location.

ex.en: Workers put a fence around the building site.
ex.zh: 工人们在建筑工地周围围起了围栏。

ex.en: The proposed hospital site is close to public transport, making healthcare more accessible to residents.
ex.zh: 拟建医院的选址靠近公共交通，方便居民获得医疗服务。

tip: site指地点或网站；sight指视力或景象，二者同音。

senses.en: To say or write something in reply.
To react to something through actions or physical changes.

ex.en: I asked about dinner, but nobody responded to my message.
ex.zh: 我发消息问晚饭怎么安排，却没人回复。

ex.en: Healthcare systems must respond quickly to changing population needs while maintaining high standards of care.
ex.zh: 医疗体系必须迅速回应不断变化的人口需求，同时维持高水平的医疗服务。

col: respond to a question｜回答问题
respond to treatment｜对治疗产生反应
tip: respond to后接回应对象，不能直接接宾语。

senses.en: an arrangement accepted by two or more people or groups
the state of sharing an opinion or accepting a proposal
a grammatical match between related words in a sentence

ex.en: We reached an agreement about sharing the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我们就共用厨房达成了协议。

ex.en: International agreements on carbon emissions are more effective when participating countries establish clear targets and monitor progress.
ex.zh: 当参与国设定明确目标并监督进展时，关于碳排放的国际协定会更加有效。

tip: 具体协议可数；表示意见一致时通常不可数。

senses.en: A system of connected people, things or places.
A group of broadcasting stations sharing programmes.
To meet people and develop useful professional relationships.

ex.en: Our home network connects three laptops and a printer.
ex.zh: 我们的家庭网络连接着三台笔记本电脑和一台打印机。

ex.en: An efficient public transport network can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 高效的公共交通网络可以缓解交通拥堵，并让人们更方便地前往工作地点。

col: network with colleagues｜与同行建立联系
tip: network强调多个节点之间相互连接。

senses.en: to have something inside or as a part
to prevent something from spreading or becoming stronger

ex.en: This small box contains all my sewing supplies.
ex.zh: 这个小盒子里装着我所有的缝纫用品。

ex.en: Processed foods often contain large amounts of salt, which can contribute to serious health problems.
ex.zh: 加工食品往往含有大量盐分，可能导致严重的健康问题。

tip: 及物动词，直接接宾语；表示“含有”时通常不用进行时。

senses.en: Natural light from the sun, or the time it is available.

ex.en: Let's finish planting these flowers while there's still daylight.
ex.zh: 趁天还亮着，我们把这些花种完吧。

ex.en: Designing classrooms to receive more daylight can reduce electricity use and create a more comfortable learning environment.
ex.zh: 在设计教室时增加自然采光，可以减少用电并营造更舒适的学习环境。

col: in broad daylight｜在光天化日之下
tip: 通常不可数；in broad daylight意为在光天化日之下。

senses.en: paper used for writing letters or short messages

ex.en: She took some notepaper from the desk drawer.
ex.zh: 她从书桌抽屉里拿出了一些便条纸。

ex.en: Providing recycled notepaper in offices is a simple measure that can support more sustainable purchasing practices.
ex.zh: 在办公室提供再生便条纸，是支持更可持续采购方式的一项简单措施。

col: a sheet of notepaper｜一张信纸
a pad of notepaper｜一本便条纸
tip: 不可数名词；一张用a sheet of notepaper。

senses.en: Towards the back, or with the back facing forwards.
In the opposite order or direction to the usual one.

ex.en: She stepped backwards to let the cyclist pass.
ex.zh: 她向后退了一步，让骑车的人过去。

ex.en: Researchers can work backwards from current pollution levels to identify the likely sources of environmental damage.
ex.zh: 研究人员可以根据当前污染水平反向追溯，找出环境破坏的可能来源。

tip: backwards是副词；修饰名词通常用backward。

senses.en: Having little colour, or less colour than usual.
Giving only a weak light.
To lose colour or seem less impressive in comparison.

ex.en: You look pale; sit down and have some water.
ex.zh: 你脸色苍白，坐下来喝点水吧。

ex.en: The financial benefits of tourism may pale in comparison with its long-term environmental costs.
ex.zh: 与旅游业带来的长期环境代价相比，其经济收益可能显得微不足道。

col: pale in comparison｜相比之下相形见绌
tip: pale可指脸色苍白或颜色浅，不等于白色。

senses.en: Difficult to do, deal with, or endure
Able to cope with hardship, pain, or difficult conditions
Strong and difficult to break, cut, or damage

ex.en: It was a tough climb, but the view was worth it.
ex.zh: 这段攀登很艰难，但沿途的风景让付出变得值得。

ex.en: Governments face tough choices when balancing economic growth with the need to protect natural resources.
ex.zh: 在平衡经济增长与保护自然资源的需求时，政府面临艰难的抉择。

tip: 读音与rough押韵；形容肉时指难嚼、老。

senses.en: Sold without certain taxes, especially to international travellers.
Without paying certain taxes on goods.

ex.en: She bought some duty-free perfume before boarding her flight.
ex.zh: 登机前，她买了一些免税香水。

ex.en: Duty-free shopping can generate substantial revenue for airports, although travellers may not always find the lowest prices.
ex.zh: 免税购物能为机场带来可观收入，但旅客未必总能买到价格最低的商品。

tip: duty此处指关税；免税商品仍受入境额度限制。

senses.en: belief in gods or spiritual powers, with related practices

ex.en: We learned about different religions at school today.
ex.zh: 今天我们在学校了解了不同的宗教。

ex.en: Schools can teach students about religion while encouraging respect for people with different beliefs.
ex.zh: 学校可以教授宗教知识，同时鼓励学生尊重持不同信仰的人。

tip: 泛指宗教时不可数；指某一种宗教时可数。

senses.en: a short sleep, usually during the day
to sleep briefly, usually during the day

ex.en: I took a short nap after lunch on Sunday.
ex.zh: 星期天午饭后，我小睡了一会儿。

ex.en: A brief afternoon nap may improve alertness, but it should not replace adequate sleep at night.
ex.zh: 下午短暂小睡可能提高警觉性，但不应代替充足的夜间睡眠。

col: a power nap｜恢复精力的短睡
tip: 动词变化要双写p：napped、napping。

senses.en: by a small amount or to a small degree

ex.en: Please open the window slightly; it feels warm.
ex.zh: 请把窗户稍微打开一点，感觉有些热。

ex.en: Although average incomes rose slightly, many households continued to struggle with higher food and energy costs.
ex.zh: 尽管平均收入略有上升，许多家庭仍难以应付不断上涨的食品和能源费用。

tip: 可修饰形容词、比较级或动词，如slightly higher。

senses.en: an official document allowing someone to do something
freedom to depart from usual rules or factual accuracy

ex.en: I keep my driving licence in my wallet.
ex.zh: 我把驾驶执照放在钱包里。

ex.en: Requiring a licence to operate tourist boats can help authorities maintain safety standards on busy waterways.
ex.zh: 要求旅游船持证运营，可以帮助主管部门维持繁忙水道的安全标准。

col: apply for a licence｜申请许可证
tip: 英式名词用licence，动词用license；美式都用license。

senses.en: A large hunting bird with powerful claws and sharp eyesight

ex.en: An eagle circled slowly above the rocky valley.
ex.zh: 一只鹰在岩石遍布的山谷上方缓缓盘旋。

ex.en: Protecting mountain forests helps preserve the hunting grounds and nesting sites of the eagle.
ex.zh: 保护山地森林有助于保全鹰的猎食区和筑巢地。

tip: eagle通常指大型猛禽；eagle-eyed形容眼力敏锐。

senses.en: an official document showing successful completion of a course

ex.en: She proudly showed her diploma to her grandparents.
ex.zh: 她自豪地向祖父母展示了自己的毕业文凭。

ex.en: A vocational diploma can provide practical skills that help graduates find employment in specialised industries.
ex.zh: 职业教育文凭课程可以提供实用技能，帮助毕业生在专业行业中找到工作。

col: diploma in nursing｜护理专业文凭
tip: diploma多指毕业或课程文凭，不等同于degree学位。

senses.en: finding something previously unknown, or the thing that is found

ex.en: We made an exciting discovery behind the old cupboard.
ex.zh: 我们在旧橱柜后有了一个令人兴奋的发现。

ex.en: The discovery of new antibiotics could help health services respond more effectively to drug-resistant infections.
ex.zh: 新抗生素的发现有助于医疗机构更有效地应对耐药性感染。

tip: discovery是发现原已存在的事物，不同于invention。

senses.en: A series of actions or changes leading to a result.
Treat materials or information through a series of organised steps.

ex.en: Making bread is a slow process, but I enjoy it.
ex.zh: 做面包是个缓慢的过程，但我很享受。

ex.en: The application process should be transparent so that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate.
ex.zh: 申请程序应当透明，以确保所有申请者都有平等的参与机会。

col: in the process of｜在……过程中
tip: in the process of后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: Performances or activities that people enjoy watching or doing.

ex.en: The hotel provides live entertainment beside the pool every evening.
ex.zh: 酒店每晚都在泳池边提供现场娱乐表演。

ex.en: Affordable entertainment facilities can improve urban life by giving residents opportunities to relax and socialise.
ex.zh: 价格亲民的娱乐设施能让居民有机会放松和社交，从而改善城市生活。

col: a form of entertainment｜一种娱乐形式
tip: 通常不可数：提供娱乐用provide entertainment。

senses.en: to think about something you do not know
a feeling of surprise and admiration
something unusually impressive or surprising

ex.en: I wonder why the cat keeps watching that cupboard.
ex.zh: 我想知道那只猫为什么一直盯着那个橱柜。

ex.en: Many parents wonder whether online lessons can provide the same social benefits as classroom learning.
ex.zh: 许多家长想知道，线上课程能否提供与课堂学习相同的社交益处。

tip: wonder后接疑问词从句时，用陈述语序。

senses.en: the act of putting something extra into something
the process of finding the total of quantities
something extra that joins an existing group or collection

ex.en: The addition of fresh lemon made the soup delicious.
ex.zh: 加入新鲜柠檬后，汤变得十分美味。

ex.en: The addition of cycle lanes can make urban transport safer and encourage residents to exercise regularly.
ex.zh: 增设自行车道可以提高城市交通的安全性，并鼓励居民经常锻炼。

col: a welcome addition｜受欢迎的新事物
tip: in addition作连接语；in addition to后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: to take goods or messages to their intended destination
to give a speech, lecture, or presentation
to produce the results or benefits that were promised

ex.en: The bakery delivers warm bread to our door every morning.
ex.zh: 面包店每天早上把热乎乎的面包送到我们家门口。

ex.en: Public transport projects must deliver clear benefits to local residents if they are to justify substantial investment.
ex.zh: 公共交通项目必须为当地居民带来明确的益处，才能证明大规模投资是合理的。

col: deliver on a promise｜兑现承诺
tip: 递送用deliver sth to sb；兑现承诺可用deliver on。

senses.en: Covered with dust or containing a lot of dust.

ex.en: I wiped the dusty shelf with a damp cloth.
ex.zh: 我用湿布擦了擦落满灰尘的架子。

ex.en: Workers in dusty environments need appropriate protective equipment to reduce their risk of developing respiratory diseases.
ex.zh: 在多尘环境中工作的人员需要适当的防护装备，以降低患呼吸系统疾病的风险。

col: a dusty road｜尘土飞扬的道路
tip: dusty形容有灰尘；dust作动词可表示掸去灰尘。

senses.en: Turned into ice or made hard by extreme cold.
Kept at very low temperatures to preserve freshness.
Feeling extremely cold.

ex.en: A frozen puddle cracked beneath my boot this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，一处结冰的水洼被我的靴子踩裂了。

ex.en: Frozen vegetables can help households reduce food waste because they remain usable much longer than fresh produce.
ex.zh: 冷冻蔬菜的保存时间比新鲜农产品长得多，因此可以帮助家庭减少食物浪费。

col: frozen with fear｜吓得动弹不得
tip: 也是freeze的过去分词；过去式为froze。

senses.en: Happen, especially at a particular time or place.
Exist or be found in a particular place or situation.
Come into someone's mind as an idea or thought.

ex.en: Power cuts often occur here during heavy winter storms.
ex.zh: 冬季强风暴来袭时，这里经常停电。

ex.en: Traffic accidents are more likely to occur when drivers are tired or distracted by mobile phones.
ex.zh: 驾驶员疲劳或因手机分心时，交通事故更容易发生。

tip: 不用于被动语态；过去式occurred，分词occurring。

senses.en: Travelling down a river on a raft for pleasure.

ex.en: We went rafting down a mountain river last weekend.
ex.zh: 上周末我们去一条山间河流漂流了。

ex.en: Rafting can support rural tourism, but operators must provide safety equipment and protect river habitats.
ex.zh: 漂流可以促进乡村旅游，但经营者必须提供安全装备并保护河流栖息地。

tip: 运动义常用go rafting；raft也指筏子。

senses.en: Cheerful and full of enjoyment.

ex.en: Their merry laughter filled the kitchen as they baked.
ex.zh: 他们烘焙时，欢快的笑声充满了厨房。

ex.en: Community festivals create a merry atmosphere that encourages residents of different ages to interact and build friendships.
ex.zh: 社区节庆营造欢乐的氛围，鼓励不同年龄的居民交流并建立友谊。

tip: 常形容欢庆气氛；make merry意为欢庆作乐。

senses.en: To give someone facts or tell them about something.
To provide knowledge that shapes a decision, opinion, or approach.

ex.en: Please inform the receptionist if you lose your key.
ex.zh: 如果你弄丢了钥匙，请告知接待员。

ex.en: Reliable research should inform government decisions about how to allocate funding for public health services.
ex.zh: 政府决定如何分配公共卫生服务资金时，应以可靠的研究为依据。

col: inform someone of something｜告知某人某事
keep someone informed｜随时告知某人最新情况
tip: 告知某人某事用inform sb of/about sth。

senses.en: The curved line of hair above each eye.

ex.en: He raised one eyebrow when he saw the enormous cake.
ex.zh: 看到那个巨大的蛋糕时，他挑起了一边眉毛。

ex.en: Facial movements, such as raising an eyebrow, can communicate surprise without relying on spoken language.
ex.zh: 挑眉等面部动作无需借助口头语言就能表达惊讶。

col: raise an eyebrow｜挑眉；表示惊讶
tip: eyebrow是眉毛；eyelash是睫毛。

senses.en: a reduction in the usual price
to sell something at a reduced price
to consider something unlikely or less important

ex.en: The shop offers a discount on winter coats.
ex.zh: 这家店的冬季外套有折扣。

ex.en: Public transport discounts can encourage more commuters to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 公共交通票价优惠能鼓励更多通勤者不开车出门。

col: discount the possibility｜不考虑这种可能性
tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词通常读/dɪsˈkaʊnt/。

senses.en: The spirit of a dead person, imagined as appearing alive.
A very slight trace of a feeling, expression, or quality.

ex.en: My little cousin dressed as a ghost for the party.
ex.zh: 我的小表弟打扮成幽灵去参加派对。

ex.en: Local ghost stories can attract tourists while revealing how communities interpret their history and cultural traditions.
ex.zh: 当地的鬼故事可以吸引游客，也能反映社区如何理解自身历史与文化传统。

col: a ghost of a smile｜一丝微笑
tip: a ghost of a smile指一丝若有若无的笑。

senses.en: To pay someone to do a job.
To pay to use something for a limited time.
An arrangement to use something temporarily in exchange for payment.

ex.en: We hired a van to move our furniture.
ex.zh: 我们租了一辆货车来搬家具。

ex.en: Businesses that hire local workers can strengthen regional economies and reduce the need for long commutes.
ex.zh: 雇用当地员工的企业可以增强区域经济，并减少长途通勤的需要。

tip: 租车英式常用hire，美式常用rent。

senses.en: Without a paid job but available for work

ex.en: My neighbour has been unemployed since the factory closed.
ex.zh: 自从工厂关闭后，我的邻居就一直失业。

ex.en: Providing affordable training for unemployed adults can help them develop skills that match changing labour market demands.
ex.zh: 为失业成年人提供负担得起的培训，可以帮助他们掌握符合劳动力市场变化需求的技能。

tip: the unemployed指失业者群体，谓语用复数。

senses.en: Hopeful, confident, or producing a good effect.
Completely certain that something is true.
Showing a condition is present, or mathematically greater than zero.

ex.en: She stayed positive even when rain spoiled our picnic.
ex.zh: 即使下雨毁了我们的野餐，她仍然保持乐观。

ex.en: Regular contact with nature can have a positive effect on children's emotional development and overall wellbeing.
ex.zh: 经常接触大自然可以对儿童的情绪发展和整体健康产生积极影响。

col: positive result｜阳性结果；良好结果
tip: 检测结果positive指阳性，不一定是好消息。

senses.en: A person who plays drums, especially in a musical group.

ex.en: The drummer tapped her sticks together before the song.
ex.zh: 歌曲开始前，女鼓手把两根鼓槌相互敲了几下。

ex.en: A skilled drummer helps musicians maintain a steady rhythm, which is essential for a coordinated live performance.
ex.zh: 熟练的鼓手帮助乐手保持稳定节奏，这对现场演出的协调至关重要。

col: a skilled drummer｜技艺娴熟的鼓手
tip: drum加-er构成drummer，注意双写m。

senses.en: to separate something into parts or share it among people
to calculate how many times one quantity fits into another
a major difference separating people or groups

ex.en: Let's divide the cake into slices before everyone arrives.
ex.zh: 趁大家还没来，我们先把蛋糕切成小块吧。

ex.en: Unequal access to reliable internet services can deepen the digital divide between urban and rural communities.
ex.zh: 获得可靠互联网服务的机会不均，可能加深城乡社区之间的数字鸿沟。

tip: divide into表示分成；divide by表示除以。

senses.en: to identify someone or something known from before
to accept or understand that something is true or important
to officially accept something or honour someone's achievements

ex.en: I recognised your brother immediately, despite his new haircut.
ex.zh: 虽然你哥哥换了发型，我还是立刻认出了他。

ex.en: Schools increasingly recognise that regular physical activity can improve both students' health and academic performance.
ex.zh: 学校日益认识到，经常运动能够改善学生的健康状况和学习表现。

col: recognise the importance of｜认识到……的重要性
tip: recognise 常见于英式英语；美式多用 recognize。

senses.en: Located above another part or nearer the top.
Higher in rank, level, or position within a range.

ex.en: Keep the spare blankets on the upper shelf.
ex.zh: 把备用毯子放在上层架子上。

ex.en: Residents on the upper floors of apartment buildings may face difficulties when lifts stop working.
ex.zh: 公寓楼高层住户在电梯停运时可能会遇到困难。

tip: 通常放在名词前，如upper floor；反义词是lower。

senses.en: The money paid for a journey on public transport.
To perform or experience a particular level of success.
Food of a particular kind served in a place.

ex.en: I had just enough coins for the bus fare.
ex.zh: 我的硬币刚好够付公交车费。

ex.en: Reducing train fares could encourage commuters to leave their cars at home and use public transport.
ex.zh: 降低火车票价可以鼓励通勤者不开车，改用公共交通。

tip: fare是交通票价；fee多指服务费或学费。

senses.en: Having a particular value in money.
Deserving the time, effort, or money something requires.
The value, importance, or usefulness of something.

ex.en: This old bicycle is still worth fifty pounds.
ex.zh: 这辆旧自行车仍然值五十英镑。

ex.en: Investing in public transport is worth the initial expense because it can reduce congestion and pollution.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通值得付出前期费用，因为这能减少拥堵和污染。

col: be worth the effort｜值得付出努力
prove your worth｜证明自己的价值
tip: 表示值得做用be worth doing，不用worth to do。

senses.en: The part of a garment that surrounds the neck.
A band worn around an animal's neck.
To catch or stop someone, often to speak to them.

ex.en: He straightened his shirt collar before the interview.
ex.zh: 面试前，他整理了一下衬衫衣领。

ex.en: A well-fitted collar allows owners to attach a lead and keep dogs under control in public spaces.
ex.zh: 合适的颈圈方便主人系上牵引绳，在公共场所管好狗。

col: turn up your collar｜竖起衣领
tip: white-collar指白领的；blue-collar指蓝领的。

senses.en: Physical harm to someone's body, often caused by an accident

ex.en: His knee injury kept him away from football practice.
ex.zh: 他的膝伤使他无法参加足球训练。

ex.en: Employers should provide regular safety training to reduce the risk of injury among workers operating heavy machinery.
ex.zh: 雇主应定期提供安全培训，以降低操作重型机械的工人受伤的风险。

tip: 具体伤处可数；泛指身体伤害时常不可数。

senses.en: to bend something so one part lies over another
a bend or crease in paper, cloth, or skin
to close because a business cannot continue operating

ex.en: Please fold these towels and put them on the shelf.
ex.zh: 请把这些毛巾叠好，放到架子上。

ex.en: Small businesses may fold when rising rental costs make it impossible to maintain a reasonable profit.
ex.zh: 当租金上涨导致无法维持合理利润时，小企业可能倒闭。

col: fold your arms｜双臂交叉抱在胸前
fold up a chair｜把椅子折起来
fold the laundry｜叠洗好的衣物
tip: fold强调折叠；bend只表示弯曲，不一定叠合。

senses.en: Able to be trusted to work well or behave consistently

ex.en: Our old car is still reliable in cold weather.
ex.zh: 我们的旧车在寒冷天气里依然很可靠。

ex.en: Access to reliable information helps citizens make informed decisions about their health and finances.
ex.zh: 获取可靠的信息有助于公民就健康和财务作出明智决定。

tip: reliable可形容人、信息或机器，强调值得信赖。

senses.en: The outside or top layer of something
To rise to the top of water
To become known or noticeable after being hidden

ex.en: Wipe the kitchen surface before you start preparing lunch.
ex.zh: 开始准备午饭前，先擦一下厨房台面。

ex.en: Dark road surfaces absorb heat during the day, contributing to higher temperatures in urban areas.
ex.zh: 深色路面白天吸收热量，导致城市地区气温升高。

tip: on the surface 指“在表面上”，也可指“表面看来”。

senses.en: A particular form of something that exists in different forms
One person's account of an event

ex.en: The new version of this app loads much faster.
ex.zh: 这个应用的新版本加载快多了。

ex.en: Comparing each witness's version of events helps investigators develop a more accurate understanding of what happened.
ex.zh: 比较各位目击者对事件的叙述，有助于调查人员更准确地了解事情的经过。

col: a version of events｜对事件的一种说法
tip: version指同一事物的不同形式，也指个人对事件的说法。

senses.en: To become liquid through heat, or make something become liquid
To become gentler emotionally, or make someone feel this way

ex.en: The butter melted quickly in the warm pan.
ex.zh: 黄油在温热的平底锅里很快就化了。

ex.en: As global temperatures rise, mountain glaciers melt faster, threatening freshwater supplies for communities downstream.
ex.zh: 随着全球气温上升，山地冰川融化加快，威胁着下游社区的淡水供应。

col: melt someone's heart｜打动某人的心
tip: melt指受热融化；dissolve指溶于液体。

senses.en: Across many places or among many people
With a large difference between people, things, or situations

ex.en: This fruit is widely available in local shops.
ex.zh: 这种水果在当地商店里随处可买到。

ex.en: Although online learning is widely accepted, access to reliable internet connections still varies considerably between regions.
ex.zh: 尽管在线学习已被广泛接受，各地区获得稳定网络连接的条件仍有很大差异。

tip: widely指范围广；wide还可表示充分张开。

senses.en: a device that joins papers using small metal staples

ex.en: Could you pass me the stapler beside your notebook?
ex.zh: 你能把笔记本旁边的订书机递给我吗？

ex.en: Providing basic office equipment, such as staplers and printers, helps community centres support residents seeking employment.
ex.zh: 提供订书机和打印机等基本办公设备，有助于社区中心为求职居民提供支持。

col: refill a stapler｜给订书机装钉
tip: stapler是订书机，staple是订书钉，也可作动词。

senses.en: Used for immediate basic care after injury or sudden illness.

ex.en: There is a first-aid kit in the kitchen cupboard.
ex.zh: 厨房橱柜里有一个急救包。

ex.en: Employers should provide first-aid training so that staff can respond effectively to minor workplace injuries.
ex.zh: 雇主应提供急救培训，让员工能够有效应对工作场所的轻伤。

tip: 名词写作first aid；置于名词前可加连字符。

senses.en: A feeling of great happiness
A person or thing that brings great happiness

ex.en: The children jumped for joy when the snow began.
ex.zh: 开始下雪时，孩子们高兴得跳了起来。

ex.en: Community gardens can bring joy to residents while strengthening social connections and encouraging healthier lifestyles.
ex.zh: 社区花园既能给居民带来欢乐，也能加强社会联系并鼓励更健康的生活方式。

col: jump for joy｜高兴得跳起来
the joys of parenthood｜为人父母的乐趣
tip: 表喜悦通常不可数；表乐事可数，如a joy。

senses.en: To leave something out or not do something expected.
To move with light hops or jump over a swinging rope.

ex.en: I skipped breakfast because I woke up too late.
ex.zh: 我起得太晚，所以没吃早餐。

ex.en: Students who regularly skip classes may struggle to develop the knowledge required for more advanced courses.
ex.zh: 经常缺课的学生可能难以掌握学习更高阶课程所需的知识。

col: skip a step｜跳过一个步骤
tip: skip后直接接宾语；skipped、skipping须双写p。

senses.en: a person whose job is to protect people or places
to protect someone or something from danger or escape
a cover or barrier that prevents injury or damage

ex.en: The guard checked my ticket before opening the gate.
ex.zh: 警卫检查了我的票才打开大门。

ex.en: Museums employ trained staff to guard valuable collections while ensuring that visitors can enjoy them safely.
ex.zh: 博物馆雇用受过培训的工作人员保护珍贵藏品，同时确保游客能够安全地观赏。

tip: guard against表示防范某种风险或错误。

senses.en: to draw a line beneath a word or phrase
to show that something is especially important

ex.en: Our teacher asked us to underline the unfamiliar words.
ex.zh: 老师让我们在不熟悉的单词下面画线。

ex.en: These findings underline the importance of providing affordable housing near public transport for families on low incomes.
ex.zh: 这些发现凸显了在公共交通附近为低收入家庭提供可负担住房的重要性。

col: underline a word｜在单词下面画线
underline the importance of｜强调…的重要性
underline the need for｜凸显对…的需要
tip: 本义是在下方画线，也常用于强调重要性。

senses.en: A small, narrow river.

senses.zh: 连续不断的人流或事物
senses.en: A continuous flow of people or things.
To flow continuously, or play media directly over the internet.

ex.en: We crossed the shallow stream on flat stones.
ex.zh: 我们踩着扁平的石头穿过了那条浅溪。

ex.en: Many students now stream educational videos at home, making reliable internet access increasingly important for learning.
ex.zh: 许多学生如今在家在线观看视频课程，因此可靠的网络连接对学习越来越重要。

col: a steady stream of visitors｜络绎不绝的访客
tip: a stream of可指接连不断的人或事物。

senses.en: A formal dance style, or a performance using this style.

ex.en: My sister practises ballet at the studio every Saturday.
ex.zh: 我姐姐每周六都在舞蹈室练习芭蕾舞。

ex.en: Public funding for ballet can help preserve artistic traditions and make performances accessible to a wider audience.
ex.zh: 为芭蕾舞提供公共资金有助于保护艺术传统，并让更多观众有机会观看演出。

tip: 词尾t不发音；英式重音在前，美式在后。

senses.en: sadness because something was not as good as expected
someone or something that fails to meet your hopes

ex.en: Her face showed disappointment when the picnic was cancelled.
ex.zh: 野餐取消时，她脸上露出了失望的神情。

ex.en: Teaching young people to cope with disappointment can help them respond more positively to academic setbacks.
ex.zh: 教年轻人应对失望，有助于他们更积极地面对学业上的挫折。

col: to my disappointment｜令我失望的是
a bitter disappointment｜极其令人失望的事
tip: 指情绪通常不可数；指令人失望的事可用a disappointment。

senses.en: a period of physical exercise to improve strength or fitness

ex.en: After a short workout, I felt ready for breakfast.
ex.zh: 短暂锻炼后，我觉得可以好好吃顿早饭了。

ex.en: A regular workout can improve physical health and help office workers manage stress more effectively.
ex.zh: 定期锻炼可以改善身体健康，并帮助办公室职员更有效地缓解压力。

tip: workout是名词；动词短语work out要分开写。

senses.en: A spiritual being believed to carry messages from God
Someone who is exceptionally kind or helpful

ex.en: The painting shows an angel with shining white wings.
ex.zh: 这幅画描绘了一位长着洁白耀眼翅膀的天使。

ex.en: Images of angels appear in religious art and can reveal important aspects of a society's beliefs.
ex.zh: 天使形象出现在宗教艺术中，能够揭示一个社会信仰的重要方面。

tip: 称某人为an angel，可表示对方善良或帮了大忙。

senses.en: The fact of no longer having someone or something.
Money lost when costs are higher than income.
A defeat in a game or competition.

ex.en: She reported the loss of her wallet yesterday.
ex.zh: 她昨天报失了钱包。
