ex.en: We tested the composition of soil in our garden.
ex.zh: 我们检测了自家花园土壤的成分。

ex.en: Changes in the composition of household waste can reveal how consumer habits develop over time.
ex.zh: 生活垃圾构成的变化可以反映消费习惯如何随时间演变。

tip: 指构成或创作过程通常不可数；指作品可数。

senses.en: covering many subjects or involving a large amount
covering a large physical area

ex.en: The storm caused extensive damage to our roof.
ex.zh: 暴风雨使我们家的屋顶大面积受损。

ex.en: Extensive research is needed before governments introduce major changes to the national education system.
ex.zh: 政府对国家教育制度进行重大改革之前，需要开展广泛研究。

tip: 强调范围广或数量多；intensive强调集中、强度高。

senses.en: To make someone want something or want to do something.

ex.en: The fresh pastries tempted me to enter the bakery.
ex.zh: 新鲜的酥点诱使我走进了面包店。

ex.en: Heavy discounts may tempt consumers to purchase products they neither need nor originally intended to buy.
ex.zh: 大幅折扣可能诱使消费者购买既不需要、也原本无意购买的产品。

col: tempt someone into doing something｜诱使某人做某事
be tempted to do something｜很想做某事
tip: 常用tempt sb to do或tempt sb into doing。

senses.en: covered wires carrying electricity or electronic signals
a thick strong rope, usually made of metal wires

ex.en: The charging cable was tangled beneath my desk.
ex.zh: 充电线在我的书桌下面缠成了一团。

ex.en: Undersea cable networks carry vast amounts of data, making them essential infrastructure for international communication and trade.
ex.zh: 海底电缆网络传输大量数据，是国际通信和贸易不可或缺的基础设施。

tip: 既可传电或信号，也可指承重用的钢缆。

senses.en: taking a lot of time to do or complete

ex.en: Sorting all these old photos is surprisingly time-consuming.
ex.zh: 整理这些旧照片竟然这么费时间。

ex.en: Applying for multiple permits can be time-consuming, discouraging small businesses from expanding their operations.
ex.zh: 申请多项许可可能很耗时，使小企业不愿扩大经营规模。

tip: 强调花费大量时间，不一定表示浪费时间。

senses.en: the main female character in a story
a woman admired for courage or remarkable achievements

ex.en: The heroine of this novel sails across the ocean.
ex.zh: 这部小说的女主角驾船横渡大洋。

ex.en: A confident heroine in children's literature can challenge stereotypes and broaden young readers' expectations.
ex.zh: 儿童文学中自信的女主角能够挑战刻板印象，拓宽小读者对未来的期待。

col: the heroine of a novel｜小说的女主角
tip: 与heroin（海洛因）同音，注意末尾的e。

senses.en: An animal that hunts and eats other animals.
A person or organisation that exploits others for personal gain.

ex.en: The rabbit froze when it noticed a predator nearby.
ex.zh: 兔子发现附近有捕食者时，一动也不敢动。

ex.en: Protecting natural predators can help farmers control pests without relying heavily on chemical pesticides.
ex.zh: 保护天敌可以帮助农民防治害虫，减少对化学农药的依赖。

tip: predator是捕食者，prey是被捕食的猎物。

senses.en: the need for something or for something to happen
something essential for everyday life

ex.en: Living far from town makes a car a necessity.
ex.zh: 住得离城镇很远，汽车就成了必需品。

ex.en: The rising cost of housing highlights the necessity of providing affordable homes for low-income families.
ex.zh: 住房成本上涨凸显了为低收入家庭提供可负担住房的必要性。

col: a necessity for｜对……而言的必需品
tip: 表必要性常不可数；表必需品可数，常用复数。

senses.en: Having no end, or seeming to continue forever.

ex.en: The queue outside the swimming pool seemed endless today.
ex.zh: 今天游泳池外的队伍似乎怎么也排不到头。

ex.en: Although online platforms offer endless entertainment, excessive screen time may reduce opportunities for meaningful social interaction.
ex.zh: 虽然网络平台提供无穷无尽的娱乐，但过多的屏幕时间可能减少有意义的社交机会。

col: an endless stream of｜源源不断的……
tip: 常为夸张，表示似乎没完没了，不一定真无终点。

senses.en: Money put into something with the aim of future profit.
Time or effort spent on something expected to bring benefits.

ex.en: Buying better tools was a good investment for our bakery.
ex.zh: 购买更好的工具对我们面包店来说是一笔不错的投资。

ex.en: Greater public investment in renewable energy could create jobs while reducing dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 加大对可再生能源的公共投资可以创造就业机会，同时减少对化石燃料的依赖。

col: investment in infrastructure｜基础设施投资
an investment of time｜时间投入
tip: 通常搭配in；表示投资行为时常作不可数名词。

senses.en: most important or central
of the best quality or in the best position
the period of greatest strength, success, or ability

ex.en: Our prime concern is getting everyone home safely tonight.
ex.zh: 我们最关心的是今晚让所有人安全到家。

ex.en: Reliable public transport is a prime requirement for cities seeking to reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 对于希望减少私家车依赖的城市而言，可靠的公共交通是一项首要需求。

col: in your prime｜处于鼎盛时期
tip: a prime example指典型例子，不是第一个例子。

senses.en: not wanting or agreeing to do something

ex.en: He was unwilling to lend his new bicycle.
ex.zh: 他不愿意把自己的新自行车借出去。

ex.en: Some commuters are unwilling to cycle to work because busy roads lack safe lanes and secure bicycle parking.
ex.zh: 一些通勤者不愿骑车上班，因为繁忙的道路缺乏安全的车道和可靠的自行车停放设施。

col: an unwilling participant｜不情愿的参与者
tip: 常用be unwilling to do；不愿做不等于unable不能做。

senses.en: To keep something at the same level or in existence.
To keep something working well through regular care and repairs.
To firmly state that something is true.

ex.en: Regular walks help me maintain a healthy weight.
ex.zh: 经常散步帮助我保持健康的体重。

ex.en: Governments must maintain essential public services while responding to growing pressure on national budgets.
ex.zh: 政府必须在应对国家预算压力不断增大的同时，维持基本公共服务。

tip: maintain后直接接宾语；表示坚持声称时可接that从句。

senses.en: old, especially when describing people

ex.en: An elderly neighbour showed me how to grow tomatoes.
ex.zh: 一位年长的邻居教我如何种番茄。

ex.en: Cities should provide accessible public transport so that elderly residents can remain active and independent.
ex.zh: 城市应提供无障碍公共交通，让老年居民能够保持活跃并独立生活。

tip: 指人年老，不指中年；older people通常更中性。

senses.en: Separate someone or something from others.
Separate or identify one substance, factor, or problem for examination.

ex.en: Heavy snow isolated the village from the nearest town.
ex.zh: 大雪使这个村庄与最近的城镇隔绝了。

ex.en: Researchers must isolate the effects of income before drawing conclusions about the relationship between education and health.
ex.zh: 研究人员必须单独厘清收入的影响，才能对教育与健康的关系下结论。

col: isolate someone from｜使某人与……隔离
isolate a variable｜单独考察一个变量
tip: 常用isolate A from B；形容词是isolated。

senses.en: To move back or away from danger or difficulty.
An act of moving back or away from something.
A quiet place where people go to rest.

ex.en: We retreated indoors when the rain began falling heavily.
ex.zh: 大雨开始倾盆而下时，我们退回了室内。

ex.en: As glaciers retreat due to rising temperatures, communities downstream face increasing uncertainty about their future water supplies.
ex.zh: 随着气温上升导致冰川退缩，下游社区未来的供水面临越来越大的不确定性。

tip: retreat强调向后撤离；静养处这一名词义也常见。

senses.en: To become larger or rounder, or make something do so.
To increase in amount or strength, or cause this.
The movement of long, smooth waves across the sea.

ex.en: My ankle began to swell after I twisted it.
ex.zh: 我扭伤脚踝后，脚踝开始肿起来。

ex.en: Seasonal tourism can swell the population of coastal towns, placing additional pressure on local water supplies.
ex.zh: 季节性旅游会使沿海城镇人口增加，给当地供水带来额外压力。

col: swell with pride｜内心充满自豪
tip: 过去式swelled；过去分词常用swollen。

senses.en: relating to photography or photographs
able to remember visual details with great accuracy

ex.en: She packed her photographic equipment before the sunrise walk.
ex.zh: 她在出发晨走看日出前收好了摄影器材。

ex.en: Photographic evidence allows researchers to document changes in glacier size and communicate climate trends to the public.
ex.zh: 照片证据使研究人员能够记录冰川大小的变化，并向公众传达气候趋势。

col: a photographic memory｜过目不忘的记忆力
tip: photographic memory指记忆极精确，并非照片存储。

senses.en: An imagined situation that is unlikely to happen
Stories featuring magic, imaginary worlds, or impossible events

ex.en: Living in a castle was my favourite childhood fantasy.
ex.zh: 住在城堡里是我童年时最喜欢的幻想。

ex.en: Fantasy literature can encourage young readers to explore moral questions through imaginary worlds and unusual characters.
ex.zh: 奇幻文学可以鼓励年轻读者通过虚构世界和不同寻常的角色探索道德问题。

tip: 具体幻想可数；表示奇幻文学类型时通常不可数。

senses.en: The circumstances surrounding an event that help explain it.
The surrounding words that help explain a word or statement.

ex.en: Her silence made sense once I understood the context.
ex.zh: 了解背景后，我就明白她为什么沉默了。

ex.en: Historical events should be examined in their social context rather than judged solely by contemporary standards.
ex.zh: 研究历史事件应结合其社会背景，而非仅以当代标准评判。

col: in context｜结合背景；在语境中
tip: out of context指脱离语境，常用于断章取义。

senses.en: Having the warm yellow colour of gold.
Especially valuable, favourable, or successful.

ex.en: The bread turned golden after twenty minutes in the oven.
ex.zh: 面包在烤箱里烤了二十分钟后变成了金黄色。

ex.en: International exchange programmes offer students a golden opportunity to develop language skills and understand different cultures.
ex.zh: 国际交流项目为学生提供了提高语言能力、了解不同文化的绝佳机会。

tip: golden多形容颜色；表示金制的通常用gold。

senses.en: relating to ideas rather than physical objects or specific examples
using shapes and colours rather than realistic images
a short summary of a research paper or other document

ex.en: She uses toys to explain abstract ideas to children.
ex.zh: 她用玩具向孩子们解释抽象概念。

ex.en: Reading the abstract helps researchers decide whether a study is relevant to their own work.
ex.zh: 阅读摘要有助于研究人员判断一项研究是否与自己的工作相关。

tip: 形容词和名词重音在首音节；动词重音在后。

senses.en: the larger part of a group, exceeding half its members
the extra votes by which one candidate or side wins

ex.en: The majority of our neighbours have dogs or cats.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居大多数都养狗或猫。

ex.en: The majority of respondents supported greater investment in public transport rather than the construction of new roads.
ex.zh: 大多数受访者支持增加公共交通投资，而非修建新道路。

col: the vast majority of｜……的绝大多数
tip: the majority of接复数名词时，谓语通常用复数。

senses.en: The person or voice telling a story

ex.en: The narrator's gentle voice helped me fall asleep.
ex.zh: 旁白者轻柔的声音帮助我入睡。

ex.en: An unreliable narrator encourages readers to question events and consider how personal perspectives shape their understanding of reality.
ex.zh: 不可靠的叙述者促使读者质疑事件，并思考个人视角如何塑造对现实的理解。

tip: 叙述者不一定是作者；小说中可由虚构人物担任。

senses.en: A word part added at the end to change meaning or grammar.

ex.en: Our teacher showed us how a suffix changes a word.
ex.zh: 老师向我们展示了后缀如何改变一个词。

ex.en: Learning common suffixes helps students recognise word classes and understand unfamiliar vocabulary in academic texts.
ex.zh: 学习常见后缀有助于学生识别词性，并理解学术文章中的陌生词汇。

tip: suffix加在词尾；prefix加在词首。

senses.en: Working together or sharing the same aims and opinions.
Joined together to form a single group or whole.

ex.en: Our neighbours remained united despite disagreements about the garden.
ex.zh: 尽管对花园有不同意见，我们的邻居们仍然保持团结。

ex.en: A united response from governments and communities is essential for addressing the long-term challenges of climate change.
ex.zh: 政府与社区一致行动，对于应对气候变化带来的长期挑战至关重要。

tip: be united in后接共同立场；united front指一致阵线。

senses.en: The scientific study of language and how it works.

ex.en: My sister studies linguistics and loves comparing different accents.
ex.zh: 我姐姐学习语言学，喜欢比较不同的口音。

ex.en: Research in linguistics can help teachers develop more effective methods for teaching foreign languages.
ex.zh: 语言学研究可以帮助教师开发更有效的外语教学方法。

tip: 虽以s结尾，作为学科名通常接单数谓语。

senses.en: a puzzling question with a clever or unexpected answer
something mysterious that is difficult to understand or explain

ex.en: My cousin asked a riddle that nobody could solve.
ex.zh: 我的表亲出了一个谁也解不开的谜语。

ex.en: The sudden disappearance of this ancient settlement remains a riddle despite decades of archaeological research.
ex.zh: 尽管经过数十年的考古研究，这座古代聚落的突然消失仍是一个谜。

tip: 谜语的答案用answer；解谜可用solve a riddle。

senses.en: Someone who works excessively and finds it hard to stop

ex.en: My brother is a workaholic who rarely takes holidays.
ex.zh: 我哥哥是个工作狂，几乎不休假。

ex.en: A workaholic may achieve short-term career success while neglecting personal relationships and long-term health.
ex.zh: 工作狂可能取得短期的职业成功，却忽视了人际关系和长期健康。

col: a self-confessed workaholic｜自认的工作狂
a workaholic culture｜过度工作的文化
tip: 强调工作过度、难以停下，不等于单纯勤奋。

senses.en: relating to armed forces or their activities
a country's armed forces, considered as a group

ex.en: We watched military helicopters carry supplies to the island.
ex.zh: 我们看着军用直升机把物资运往岛上。

ex.en: Governments must balance military spending with investment in essential public services such as healthcare and education.
ex.zh: 政府必须平衡军事开支与医疗、教育等基本公共服务的投入。

tip: 作名词指整体军队时，通常用the military。

senses.en: to make something harder to understand or deal with

ex.en: Changing the date now would only complicate our plans.
ex.zh: 现在改日期只会让我们的计划更难安排。

ex.en: Unclear regulations can complicate efforts to establish small businesses, particularly in rapidly developing urban areas.
ex.zh: 不明确的法规会增加创办小企业的难度，在快速发展的城市地区尤其如此。

col: complicate the situation｜使局势复杂化
complicate the process｜使过程复杂化
tip: 及物动词，后接被弄复杂的事物。

senses.en: a book or product that sells in very large quantities

ex.en: That cookbook became a best-seller within a month.
ex.zh: 那本食谱不到一个月就成了畅销书。

ex.en: A best-seller can encourage wider public interest in scientific issues that previously attracted little attention.
ex.zh: 一本畅销书能够激发公众对以往鲜受关注的科学议题的广泛兴趣。

col: a best-seller list｜畅销书排行榜
tip: 也常写作bestseller；形容词用best-selling。

senses.en: The feeling of being tired and wanting to sleep.

ex.en: A short walk helped me shake off my sleepiness.
ex.zh: 散了一小会儿步后，我驱散了困意。

ex.en: Persistent daytime sleepiness can affect students' concentration and reduce their ability to absorb new information.
ex.zh: 白天持续困倦会影响学生的注意力，降低他们吸收新信息的能力。

tip: 不可数名词，指想睡的感觉，不等于已经入睡。

senses.en: a sudden strong feeling of excitement and pleasure
to make someone feel very excited and pleased

ex.en: I felt a real thrill when the kite finally flew.
ex.zh: 风筝终于飞起来时，我感到一阵真正的兴奋。

ex.en: The thrill of discovery can motivate students to explore scientific questions beyond the classroom.
ex.zh: 发现新事物带来的兴奋感可以激励学生在课堂之外探索科学问题。

col: the thrill of discovery｜发现的兴奋感
a thrill of excitement｜一阵兴奋
tip: thrilled表示人很兴奋；thrilling表示事物令人兴奋。

senses.en: To become red in the face from embarrassment or shyness.
Redness in the face caused by embarrassment or shyness.

ex.en: He began to blush when everyone praised his singing.
ex.zh: 大家夸赞他的歌声时，他开始脸红了。

ex.en: Students who blush during presentations may benefit from supportive feedback and regular opportunities to practise speaking.
ex.zh: 演讲时容易脸红的学生可能会受益于鼓励性的反馈和经常练习口头表达的机会。

tip: 动词通常不及物；使某人脸红用make someone blush。

senses.en: A person who takes part in a competition.

ex.en: Each contestant brought a homemade cake for the judges.
ex.zh: 每位参赛者都带来了自制蛋糕供评委品评。

ex.en: Every contestant in a televised competition should receive clear guidance about the judging criteria beforehand.
ex.zh: 电视竞赛中的每位参赛者都应事先获得有关评判标准的明确说明。

col: contestant in a competition｜比赛中的参赛者
quiz show contestant｜问答节目的选手
tip: contestant指参赛者；participant也可指普通活动参与者。

senses.en: to limit what someone can do or how much is allowed

ex.en: These tight shoes restrict my movement when I dance.
ex.zh: 这双鞋太紧，跳舞时让我施展不开。

ex.en: Local authorities may restrict private vehicle access to city centres in order to reduce air pollution.
ex.zh: 地方政府可能限制私家车进入市中心，以减少空气污染。

col: restrict something to｜将某事物限定于
tip: restrict A to B表示“把A限定在B范围内”。

senses.zh: 油漆装潢工；室内装饰师
senses.en: Someone whose job is painting, wallpapering, or decorating rooms.

ex.en: The decorator covered our sofa before painting the ceiling.
ex.zh: 装潢工在粉刷天花板前把我们的沙发盖了起来。

ex.en: Employing a professional decorator can help homeowners improve their living space without undertaking major structural changes.
ex.zh: 聘请专业装饰人员可以帮助房主改善居住空间，而不必大幅改动房屋结构。

tip: 英式英语常指刷墙、贴墙纸的工人，不仅是设计师。

senses.en: A person or animal that lives in a particular place.

ex.en: Every inhabitant of the village helped repair the bridge.
ex.zh: 村里的每一位居民都帮忙修了桥。

ex.en: Rapid urban growth can place pressure on housing and reduce access to green spaces for local inhabitants.
ex.zh: 城市快速扩张可能增加住房压力，并减少当地居民享用绿地的机会。

col: the inhabitants of a city｜一座城市的居民
tip: 常用inhabitants of＋地点；不等于具有公民身份的citizens。

senses.en: a feeling of enjoying or being fond of something

ex.en: I've developed a liking for spicy soup this winter.
ex.zh: 今年冬天，我渐渐喜欢上了辣汤。

ex.en: Children who develop a liking for outdoor activities may be more willing to adopt healthy habits later in life.
ex.zh: 喜欢上户外活动的儿童，日后可能更愿意养成健康的生活习惯。

col: take a liking to｜开始喜欢上
develop a liking for｜逐渐喜欢上
tip: a liking for表示喜欢；to your liking表示合心意。

senses.en: Related to art or the creation of art
Good at creating or appreciating art
Beautiful or attractive in a way that shows creative skill

ex.en: The festival celebrates artistic traditions through music and dance.
ex.zh: 这个节日通过音乐和舞蹈颂扬艺术传统。

ex.en: Schools should provide opportunities for artistic expression, as creative activities can support emotional development and cultural understanding.
ex.zh: 学校应提供艺术表达的机会，因为创意活动有助于情感发展和文化理解。

tip: artistic指艺术或艺术天赋；artificial指人造的。

senses.en: A place or situation offering great beauty, happiness, or enjoyment
A perfect place of happiness after death in some religions

ex.en: This quiet beach is a paradise for swimmers.
ex.zh: 这片宁静的海滩是游泳爱好者的乐园。

ex.en: Although tourism can turn remote islands into holiday paradises, uncontrolled development may damage the ecosystems that attract visitors.
ex.zh: 尽管旅游业能将偏远岛屿变成度假天堂，无序开发却可能破坏吸引游客的生态系统。

col: a paradise for wildlife｜野生动物的乐园
tip: a paradise for后接人或动物，表示其理想乐园。

senses.en: A pile of things placed together without careful arrangement.
To put things together in a large pile.

ex.en: He left his clothes in a heap beside the bed.
ex.zh: 他把衣服乱堆在床边。

ex.en: Large heaps of discarded clothing highlight the environmental consequences of rapid consumption in the fashion industry.
ex.zh: 成堆的废弃衣物凸显了时尚行业快速消费带来的环境后果。

col: a heap of clothes｜一堆衣服
tip: a heap of 指一堆；heaps of 口语中表示大量。

senses.en: a brief or incomplete view of someone or something
to see someone or something briefly or only partly

ex.en: We caught a glimpse of a fox behind the fence.
ex.zh: 我们瞥见篱笆后面有一只狐狸。

ex.en: Museum exhibitions offer visitors a glimpse of daily life in societies that existed thousands of years ago.
ex.zh: 博物馆展览让参观者得以一窥数千年前社会的日常生活。

col: offer a glimpse into｜让人略窥
tip: glimpse强调短暂看见；glance强调主动匆匆看一眼。

senses.en: aware of something or noticing that it exists
awake and able to notice and respond to your surroundings
done deliberately rather than automatically

ex.en: I became conscious of someone standing behind me.
ex.zh: 我察觉到有人站在我身后。

ex.en: Consumers are increasingly conscious of the environmental impact of their purchases and are choosing more sustainable products.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越意识到购物对环境的影响，并开始选择更可持续的产品。

col: a conscious effort｜有意识的努力
a conscious decision｜有意作出的决定
tip: 意识到某事用be conscious of，勿与conscience混淆。

senses.en: Without a permanent place to live.

ex.en: The flood left several families homeless in our town.
ex.zh: 洪水使我们镇上的几户家庭无家可归。

ex.en: Affordable housing and accessible support services are essential to helping homeless people rebuild stable lives.
ex.zh: 经济适用的住房和便利的援助服务，对帮助无家可归者重建稳定生活至关重要。

col: leave someone homeless｜使某人无家可归
a homeless shelter｜无家可归者收容所
tip: 不能说a homeless；应说a homeless person。

senses.en: comments about performance or work that help someone improve

ex.en: My tutor gave me helpful feedback on my essay.
ex.zh: 导师针对我的作文给了我有用的反馈。

ex.en: Regular feedback enables students to identify weaknesses and develop more effective strategies for independent learning.
ex.zh: 定期反馈能帮助学生发现薄弱之处，并制定更有效的自主学习策略。

tip: 不可数，不说a feedback或feedbacks；用some feedback。

senses.en: To suddenly surprise or frighten someone

ex.en: The sudden knock startled me while I was cooking.
ex.zh: 我做饭时，突然的敲门声吓了我一跳。

ex.en: Loud construction noises can startle nearby wildlife and disrupt their feeding patterns during the breeding season.
ex.zh: 繁殖季节，巨大的施工噪声会惊吓附近的野生动物，扰乱它们的觅食规律。

tip: 强调突然受惊，不等于长期感到害怕。

senses.en: to pay back money that you owe
to give something in return for help or kindness

ex.en: I will repay the money when I get paid.
ex.zh: 等发了工资，我就把钱还上。

ex.en: Graduates may struggle to repay their student loans if secure employment opportunities remain limited.
ex.zh: 如果稳定的就业机会仍然有限，毕业生可能难以偿还助学贷款。

col: repay someone's kindness｜报答某人的好意
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为repaid；不表示报复。

senses.en: Deep sadness, especially after someone you love has died

ex.en: She found comfort in friends during her grief.
ex.zh: 在悲痛中，她从朋友那里得到了慰藉。

ex.en: Schools should offer counselling to help young people manage grief after the loss of a family member.
ex.zh: 学校应提供心理辅导，帮助年轻人在失去家人后应对悲痛。

tip: 表示悲痛时通常不可数，常与失去亲人有关。

senses.en: using the basic meaning of words, without metaphor
following the exact words rather than the overall meaning

ex.en: I meant cold feet in the literal sense.
ex.zh: 我说的就是脚冷，没有什么比喻含义。

ex.en: A literal translation may preserve individual words while failing to convey the cultural meaning of an expression.
ex.zh: 逐字翻译可能保留每个词，却无法传达某种表达背后的文化含义。

tip: literal指字面义；literary指文学的，注意区别。

senses.en: To make something easier to understand by explaining it clearly.
To make a liquid clearer by removing unwanted substances.

ex.en: Could you clarify which entrance we should use?
ex.zh: 你能说清楚我们应该走哪个入口吗？

ex.en: Governments should clarify how personal data will be used before introducing digital identity systems.
ex.zh: 政府在推行数字身份系统前，应阐明个人数据将如何使用。

tip: clarify直接接需要解释的内容，如clarify the rules。

senses.en: Working together with others to achieve a shared goal
Helping an enemy that controls your country

ex.en: Our garden makeover was a collaboration between several neighbours.
ex.zh: 我们花园的改造是几位邻居合作完成的。

ex.en: Closer collaboration between universities and local businesses can help students develop practical skills before entering the workforce.
ex.zh: 大学与当地企业更紧密的合作可以帮助学生在就业前培养实用技能。

tip: 普通语境指合作；通敌义须结合战争背景。

senses.en: A long gun held against the shoulder when fired.
To search through things quickly, often leaving them untidy.

ex.en: An old rifle stood inside the museum's glass cabinet.
ex.zh: 博物馆的玻璃展柜里立着一支旧步枪。

ex.en: The museum displays a nineteenth-century rifle to illustrate how industrial advances transformed military equipment.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了一支十九世纪的步枪，以说明工业进步如何改变军事装备。

tip: 作动词时常用rifle through，表示匆忙翻找。

senses.en: Someone who does not belong to a particular group.
A competitor considered unlikely to win.

ex.en: At first, I felt like an outsider at school.
ex.zh: 起初，我觉得自己在学校里像个局外人。

ex.en: An outsider may identify weaknesses in an organisation that its long-standing members have failed to notice.
ex.zh: 局外人可能发现一个组织中资深成员未曾注意到的弱点。

col: feel like an outsider｜觉得自己是局外人
an outsider's perspective｜局外人的视角
a rank outsider｜极不被看好的竞争者
tip: 既可指圈外人，也可指不被看好的参赛者。

senses.en: To draw someone's attention away from what they are doing

ex.en: The music distracted me while I was doing homework.
ex.zh: 我做作业时，音乐让我分心了。

ex.en: Frequent phone notifications can distract employees from complex tasks and reduce their ability to concentrate for long periods.
ex.zh: 频繁的手机通知会使员工在处理复杂任务时分心，并削弱他们长时间集中注意力的能力。

col: distract someone from｜使某人从……分心
distract attention from｜转移对……的注意力
tip: 常用distract sb from sth或doing sth。

senses.en: Riding a board across water while pulled by a kite.

ex.en: My cousin tried kitesurfing at the beach yesterday.
ex.zh: 我表亲昨天在海滩尝试了风筝冲浪。

ex.en: Coastal resorts offering kitesurfing should separate training areas from swimming zones to reduce accidents.
ex.zh: 提供风筝冲浪活动的海滨度假区应将训练区与游泳区分开，以减少事故。

tip: 指由风筝牵引滑行，区别于帆板运动windsurfing。

senses.en: without restrictions or anything preventing movement or action
openly and honestly, without hiding thoughts or facts
willingly and generously, without being forced

ex.en: The chickens wander freely around the garden all day.
ex.zh: 这些鸡整天在花园里自由走动。

ex.en: Students should be able to express their opinions freely while respecting the rights and feelings of others.
ex.zh: 学生应能自由表达意见，同时尊重他人的权利和感受。

tip: freely主要指不受限制；免费用for free。

senses.en: to use rude words because you are angry
words intended to bring someone bad luck through magic
something that causes serious trouble or suffering

ex.en: He cursed quietly when his umbrella broke in the rain.
ex.zh: 雨中伞坏了，他低声咒骂了一句。

ex.en: For isolated communities, unreliable transport can be a curse that limits access to healthcare and employment.
ex.zh: 对偏远社区而言，不可靠的交通可能成为祸害，限制居民获得医疗服务和就业机会。

col: curse under one's breath｜低声咒骂
put a curse on｜对……施加诅咒
a blessing and a curse｜既是福也是祸
tip: curse可指咒骂或诅咒；swear也可指发誓。

senses.en: An amount of food or drink intended for one person.
Currently holding an official position or working in the armed forces.

ex.en: Would you like another serving of soup before dessert?
ex.zh: 吃甜点前，你还想再来一份汤吗？

ex.en: Clear information about calories per serving can help consumers compare products and make more informed dietary choices.
ex.zh: 清楚标明每份食品的热量，有助于消费者比较产品，作出更明智的饮食选择。

tip: 食物的serving是可数名词，常用a serving of。

senses.en: happening or available inside a physical shop
inside a physical shop rather than online

ex.en: The shop is offering free in-store cooking demonstrations today.
ex.zh: 这家店今天提供免费的店内烹饪演示。

ex.en: Despite the growth of online shopping, in-store services remain important for customers who need personalised advice.
ex.zh: 尽管网购不断发展，店内服务对于需要个性化建议的顾客仍然重要。

tip: in-store指店内的；“有库存”通常说in stock。

senses.en: the state of remaining alive or continuing to exist

ex.en: The lost hikers carried blankets and other survival equipment.
ex.zh: 迷路的徒步者带着毯子和其他求生装备。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for the survival of species threatened by climate change.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地对于受气候变化威胁的物种生存至关重要。

col: fight for survival｜为生存而斗争
tip: survival指生存状态；幸存者用survivor。

senses.en: Behaving sensibly and showing good judgment
Fully grown or developed
To become fully developed or more sensible

ex.en: Leila gave a mature response when her plans changed.
ex.zh: 计划改变时，莱拉作出了成熟理智的回应。

ex.en: Living independently can help young adults mature as they learn to manage money and resolve everyday problems.
ex.zh: 独立生活能帮助年轻人在学习理财和解决日常问题的过程中变得成熟。

col: a mature student｜成年后重返校园的学生
tip: 既可指身体发育成熟，也可指处事明智。

senses.en: the legal status of belonging to a particular country
responsible participation in the life of a community

ex.en: She applied for citizenship after living here for years.
ex.zh: 在这里生活多年后，她申请了公民身份。

ex.en: Citizenship education can help young people understand their rights and responsibilities while encouraging active participation in democratic processes.
ex.zh: 公民教育能帮助年轻人理解自己的权利与责任，同时鼓励他们积极参与民主进程。

col: apply for citizenship｜申请公民身份
tip: 通常不可数；区别于residency（居留资格）。

senses.en: A heavy object that holds a boat in place underwater.
To secure a boat with an anchor or fix something firmly.
A person or thing providing stability and support.

ex.en: We dropped the anchor beside a quiet island.
ex.zh: 我们在一座宁静的小岛旁抛了锚。

ex.en: Strong community networks can provide an anchor for families adapting to life in unfamiliar cities.
ex.zh: 紧密的社区网络可以为适应陌生城市生活的家庭提供可靠的依靠。

tip: drop anchor指抛锚；weigh anchor指起锚，不是称重。

senses.en: Medicines used to treat infections caused by bacteria.

ex.en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics for my ear infection.
ex.zh: 医生给我开了抗生素来治疗耳部感染。

ex.en: Overusing antibiotics can make bacterial infections harder to treat, creating a serious challenge for public health.
ex.zh: 过度使用抗生素会增加细菌感染的治疗难度，给公共卫生带来严峻挑战。

col: a course of antibiotics｜一个疗程的抗生素
tip: 是antibiotic的复数；抗生素不能治疗病毒感染。

senses.en: To force out lava, ash, or gas from a volcano.
To begin suddenly with strong emotion, noise, or activity.

ex.en: We watched the volcano erupt in a nature documentary.
ex.zh: 我们在一部自然纪录片里看到了火山喷发。

ex.en: When volcanoes erupt, clouds of ash can disrupt air travel and affect communities far from the crater.
ex.zh: 火山喷发时，火山灰云可能扰乱航空运输，并影响远离火山口的社区。

col: erupt into applause｜突然爆发掌声
tip: 通常作不及物动词；erupt into后可接掌声等。

senses.en: a strong desire for more than one needs or deserves

ex.en: His greed left everyone else without any cake.
ex.zh: 他太贪吃，其他人连一点蛋糕也没分到。

ex.en: Corporate greed can undermine environmental protection when companies prioritise short-term profits over the welfare of local communities.
ex.zh: 当企业将短期利润置于当地社区福祉之上时，企业的贪婪就可能破坏环境保护。

col: greed for power｜对权力的贪欲
tip: 不可数名词；greed for后接金钱、权力等渴求对象。

senses.en: Make an agreement or permission valid for a further period.
Start something again or restore its strength.

ex.en: I need to renew my library books tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天需要续借图书馆的书。

ex.en: Governments should renew their commitment to public transport as urban populations continue to grow.
ex.zh: 随着城市人口持续增长，政府应重新坚定发展公共交通的承诺。

col: renew a library book｜续借图书馆的书
tip: renew侧重延长有效期或重新开始，不等于更新信息。

senses.en: Produce crops, profits, or other results
The amount of a crop, product, or profit produced
Stop resisting, or allow someone else to go first

ex.en: Our apple tree yielded three baskets of fruit.
ex.zh: 我们的苹果树结出了三篮果实。

ex.en: Investment in agricultural research can yield substantial benefits for food security without expanding farmland.
ex.zh: 对农业研究的投资可以在不扩大耕地的情况下，为粮食安全带来显著益处。

tip: yield results指产生结果；yield to指向……让步。

senses.en: An official group appointed to investigate or manage something
Payment based on the value of sales or services
To formally ask someone to produce work for payment

ex.en: The gallery commissioned a local artist to paint our harbour.
ex.zh: 美术馆委托一位本地画家描绘我们的港口。

ex.en: An independent commission should investigate housing conditions before the government introduces new safety regulations for rental properties.
ex.zh: 在政府出台新的出租房安全法规前，独立委员会应调查住房状况。

col: commission a report｜委托撰写报告
commission a painting｜委托创作画作
tip: 作委员会是可数名词；作佣金常用不可数形式。

senses.en: an act of saying you will not do or accept something

ex.en: His polite refusal did not upset the host.
ex.zh: 他礼貌的谢绝并没有让主人不快。

ex.en: A government's refusal to address public concerns can weaken trust and reduce participation in democratic processes.
ex.zh: 政府拒绝处理公众关切可能削弱信任，并降低公众参与民主程序的意愿。

tip: 表示拒绝做某事，用refusal to do，不用of doing。

senses.en: Willing to take risks or try unusually bold things.
The courage to take risks or attempt difficult things.

ex.en: Her daring outfit featured a bright orange cape.
ex.zh: 她大胆的穿搭中有一件鲜橙色披风。

ex.en: The architect proposed a daring design that combined affordable housing with extensive rooftop gardens.
ex.zh: 这位建筑师提出了一个大胆的设计，将经济适用住房与大面积屋顶花园结合起来。

col: a daring rescue｜大胆的营救行动
tip: 作形容词强调敢冒险；作名词时通常不可数。

senses.en: A basic structure of ideas or rules supporting something
A supporting structure that gives something its shape

ex.en: Our coach gave us a framework for planning each workout.
ex.zh: 教练给了我们一个规划每次训练的基本框架。

ex.en: Governments need a clear legal framework to protect personal information collected by online services.
ex.zh: 政府需要明确的法律框架，以保护网络服务收集的个人信息。

col: within the framework of｜在……框架内
tip: 常用a framework for sth，表示某事的基本框架。

senses.en: to talk too proudly about your achievements or possessions

ex.en: He always brags about how fast he can swim.
ex.zh: 他总是吹嘘自己游泳有多快。

ex.en: Social media can encourage users to brag about personal achievements rather than discuss everyday challenges honestly.
ex.zh: 社交媒体可能鼓励用户夸耀个人成就，而不是坦诚讨论日常挑战。

col: brag that you won｜吹嘘自己赢了
tip: 常接 about 或 that；过去式 bragged 双写 g。

senses.en: Expecting good things to happen or a situation to improve.

ex.en: Despite the rain, we remained optimistic about our picnic.
ex.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们仍对野餐抱有希望。

ex.en: Many graduates remain optimistic about their career prospects despite increasing competition in the labour market.
ex.zh: 尽管劳动力市场的竞争日益激烈，许多毕业生仍对自己的职业前景保持乐观。

tip: 常用be optimistic about；反义词是pessimistic。

senses.en: the provision of money for a purchase, business, or project

ex.en: We need financing before we can open the bakery.
ex.zh: 我们需要先筹到资金，才能开这家面包店。

ex.en: Access to affordable financing allows small businesses to invest in cleaner technology and create local jobs.
ex.zh: 获得成本可负担的融资，让小企业能够投资清洁技术并创造本地就业机会。

tip: 指提供或筹措资金；金融学通常用finance。

senses.en: Traditions, buildings, and values passed down from earlier generations.

ex.en: These old songs are part of our family heritage.
ex.zh: 这些老歌是我们家族传承的一部分。

ex.en: Protecting cultural heritage can strengthen community identity while attracting visitors who support local businesses.
ex.zh: 保护文化遗产能够增强社区认同感，同时吸引游客，支持当地商业。

col: preserve our heritage｜保护我们的遗产
rich heritage｜丰富的历史文化遗产
tip: 多指文化与历史传承；个人继承财产常用inheritance。

senses.en: Someone whose job involves hard physical work.

ex.en: A laborer carried heavy bricks across the building site.
ex.zh: 一名劳工扛着沉重的砖块穿过建筑工地。

ex.en: Every construction laborer should receive safety training and suitable protective equipment before starting work on site.
ex.zh: 每位建筑劳工都应在进场工作前接受安全培训，并获得合适的防护装备。

tip: 美式拼写；英式为labourer，强调体力劳动。

senses.en: An expression of opposition, or a reason for opposing something.

ex.en: My only objection is that the tickets cost too much.
ex.zh: 我唯一的反对理由是票价太高。

ex.en: Residents raised an objection to the proposed airport expansion because of its likely impact on noise levels.
ex.zh: 居民对拟议的机场扩建提出异议，因为这可能加剧噪声。

tip: objection to中的to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: in a way that is easy to perceive or remember
to a noticeable or unmistakable degree

ex.en: I distinctly remember leaving my keys beside the kettle.
ex.zh: 我清楚地记得把钥匙放在水壶旁边了。

ex.en: Residents felt distinctly safer after the council improved street lighting and introduced regular evening bus services.
ex.zh: 市政部门改善路灯并开通定时晚间公交后，居民明显感到更安全了。

tip: distinctly可修饰记忆、感知，也可强调程度。

senses.en: a valuable stone, often cut and polished for jewellery

senses.zh: 精品；难得的好人或事物
senses.en: a person or thing of exceptional quality or value

ex.en: The tiny blue gem sparkled in her silver ring.
ex.zh: 她银戒指上的那颗小蓝宝石闪闪发光。

ex.en: Small regional museums often contain hidden gems that reveal important aspects of a community's cultural history.
ex.zh: 地方小型博物馆往往藏有鲜为人知的珍品，展现一个社区文化历史的重要方面。

col: a gem of a book｜一本难得的好书
tip: hidden gem常指尚未广为人知的好地方或精品。

senses.en: Done or working without receiving money.
Not yet paid or settled.

ex.en: She does unpaid work at the animal shelter every Saturday.
ex.zh: 她每周六都在动物收容所做无偿工作。

ex.en: Unpaid internships can disadvantage students who cannot afford to work without a regular income.
ex.zh: 无薪实习可能使那些无法承受没有固定收入的学生处于不利地位。

tip: unpaid work指无偿工作；unpaid bills指未付账单。

senses.en: Extremely good or impressive.
Beautiful and impressive in appearance.

ex.en: We had a splendid picnic beside the lake yesterday.
ex.zh: 我们昨天在湖边度过了一段美好的野餐时光。

ex.en: Restoring historic gardens gives urban residents a splendid opportunity to enjoy nature and learn about local heritage.
ex.zh: 修复历史花园为城市居民提供了亲近自然、了解当地文化遗产的绝佳机会。

tip: 既可赞事物极好，也可形容景色壮丽。

senses.en: suitable for a particular situation or purpose
to take something for your own use without permission
to officially set aside money for a particular purpose

ex.en: Are these shoes appropriate for a long mountain walk?
ex.zh: 这双鞋适合长时间山间徒步吗？

ex.en: Governments should provide appropriate training to help workers adapt to technological changes in the labour market.
ex.zh: 政府应提供适当培训，帮助劳动者适应劳动力市场中的技术变革。

tip: 形容词词尾读/ət/，动词读/eɪt/。

senses.en: How strongly a material resists scratching, cutting, or denting.
The amount of dissolved calcium and magnesium in water.

ex.en: The hardness of this wood makes it difficult to carve.
ex.zh: 这种木材硬度高，很难雕刻。

ex.en: Engineers assess the hardness of different materials before selecting suitable components for bridges and other major structures.
ex.zh: 工程师在为桥梁等大型结构选择合适的构件前，会评估不同材料的硬度。

tip: hardness 指硬度；hardship 才指困苦。

senses.en: A feeling that something pleasant or exciting will happen.
The expected length of life or duration of something.

ex.en: The children watched the curtain rise with eager expectancy.
ex.zh: 孩子们满怀期待地看着幕布升起。

ex.en: Improved sanitation and access to healthcare have increased life expectancy in many parts of the world.
ex.zh: 卫生条件的改善和医疗服务的普及提高了世界许多地区的人均预期寿命。

col: an air of expectancy｜期待的气氛
tip: life expectancy指预期寿命，不等于实际寿命。

senses.en: The quality of being easy, useful, or suitable.
Something that makes daily life easier.

ex.en: I keep spare keys here for convenience when guests visit.
ex.zh: 我把备用钥匙放在这里，方便客人来访时使用。

ex.en: Although online shopping offers convenience, it may encourage unnecessary spending and increase packaging waste.
ex.zh: 虽然网上购物带来了便利，但它可能助长不必要的消费，并增加包装垃圾。

tip: 表示“方便”通常不可数；形容词是convenient。

senses.en: Preparing writing, images, or recordings by correcting and arranging them.
Correcting or arranging material to prepare it for use.

ex.en: Editing these holiday videos took me all afternoon.
ex.zh: 剪辑这些假期视频花了我整整一个下午。

ex.en: Careful editing helps researchers present complex findings clearly and makes academic articles easier to understand.
ex.zh: 仔细编辑有助于研究人员清晰地呈现复杂的发现，也让学术文章更易理解。

tip: 可作名词，也可作edit的现在分词。

senses.en: a group of ships controlled or operated together
vehicles or aircraft owned or operated by one organisation

ex.en: A fleet of fishing boats returned before sunset.
ex.zh: 一支捕鱼船队在日落前返航了。

ex.en: Replacing the city's ageing bus fleet with electric vehicles could significantly reduce air pollution in residential areas.
ex.zh: 用电动车辆替换该市老旧的公交车队，可以显著减少居民区的空气污染。

col: a fleet of vehicles｜一支车队
tip: 集合名词；a fleet of可接船、车辆或飞机。

senses.en: designed to be useful rather than decorative
working correctly and ready for use
relating to the purpose or operation of something

ex.en: The kitchen is small but functional, with plenty of storage.
ex.zh: 这个厨房虽小却很实用，有充足的储物空间。

ex.en: Public housing should provide functional living spaces that meet the daily needs of diverse households.
ex.zh: 公共住房应提供实用的居住空间，满足不同家庭的日常需求。

col: fully functional｜功能完备且运作正常的
tip: functional可指实用，也可指设备能正常工作。

senses.en: A large, special meal with plenty of food.
Something that gives great pleasure to the senses.
To eat and enjoy a large amount of food.

ex.en: We prepared a feast for the whole family.
ex.zh: 我们为全家准备了一顿盛宴。

ex.en: Traditional festivals often include a communal feast that strengthens relationships and preserves local food culture.
ex.zh: 传统节日常有集体宴席，既增进人际关系，也传承当地饮食文化。

col: a feast for the eyes｜视觉盛宴
tip: 动词常用feast on，表示尽情享用某种食物。

senses.en: pleasantly round and full in shape
to make a cushion or pillow fuller by shaking it

ex.en: She picked a plump peach from the fruit bowl.
ex.zh: 她从果盘里挑了一个饱满的桃子。

ex.en: Consumers often prefer plump fruit, although appearance alone is not a reliable indicator of nutritional value.
ex.zh: 消费者往往偏爱饱满的水果，但单凭外观并不能可靠地判断营养价值。

col: plump up a pillow｜把枕头拍蓬松
tip: 比fat语气温和，但描述他人体型仍需谨慎。

senses.en: Someone who formally requests a job, place, or permission.

ex.en: Each applicant waited outside the office for an interview.
ex.zh: 每位申请人都在办公室外等候面试。

ex.en: Universities should assess each applicant fairly, considering both academic achievement and relevant personal experience.
ex.zh: 大学应公平评估每位申请人，兼顾学业成绩与相关个人经历。

col: applicant for a position｜职位申请人
tip: 申请某职位的人用 applicant for a position。

senses.en: A difference of opinion or an argument about it.

ex.en: We had a disagreement about whose turn it was.
ex.zh: 我们为该轮到谁了发生了争执。

ex.en: Disagreement over public spending priorities is inevitable, but transparent discussions can help governments build broader support.
ex.zh: 在公共支出优先事项上出现分歧不可避免，但透明的讨论能帮助政府获得更广泛的支持。

col: a disagreement over something｜关于某事的分歧
tip: 具体争执可数；泛指意见不合时通常不可数。

senses.en: achieving a lot or producing useful results
producing large amounts of crops, goods, or other outputs

ex.en: I had a productive morning and finished my report.
ex.zh: 我上午效率很高，完成了报告。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help employees remain productive while balancing professional responsibilities with family commitments.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排可以帮助员工兼顾工作职责和家庭义务，同时保持高效。

col: a productive discussion｜富有成效的讨论
tip: 形容工作或讨论有成果；产量或效率用productivity。

senses.en: great unhappiness or suffering
extremely poor and uncomfortable living conditions

ex.en: The constant noise made her life a misery.
ex.zh: 持续不断的噪声让她苦不堪言。

ex.en: Improving access to affordable housing can reduce the misery experienced by families living in overcrowded temporary accommodation.
ex.zh: 改善可负担住房的供应，可以减轻住在拥挤临时住所中的家庭所承受的痛苦。

col: make someone's life a misery｜使某人苦不堪言
tip: 通常不可数；a misery可指令人痛苦的处境。

senses.en: Older than another person, especially within the same family
An older person, especially one respected within a community

ex.en: My elder sister taught me how to ride a bicycle.
ex.zh: 我姐姐教会了我骑自行车。

ex.en: Community elders can help preserve local traditions by sharing their knowledge and experiences with younger generations.
ex.zh: 社区长者可以通过向年轻一代分享知识和经历，帮助传承当地传统。

tip: elder 多放在亲属名词前；比较年龄用 older than。

senses.en: Something that happens because of an action or situation.
The quality of being important or worth considering.

ex.en: Missing the last bus was a consequence of leaving late.
ex.zh: 错过末班车是出发太晚造成的结果。

ex.en: One serious consequence of rapid urban growth is increased pressure on public transport and housing.
ex.zh: 城市快速扩张的一个严重后果是公共交通和住房承受的压力增大。

tip: as a consequence of后接原因，意为“由于”。

senses.en: An object used to make something look more attractive.
To decorate something with attractive objects or details.

ex.en: A small glass ornament sparkled on the wooden shelf.
ex.zh: 木架上的一件小玻璃饰品闪闪发亮。

ex.en: Traditional ornaments displayed in local museums can reveal how earlier communities expressed cultural identity through decorative objects.
ex.zh: 当地博物馆展出的传统饰品，可以揭示过去的社区如何通过装饰物表达文化认同。

tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词末音节读/ment/。

senses.en: Extremely good, enjoyable, or impressive.
Remarkably large in amount, value, or extent.
Existing in traditional stories rather than in reality.

ex.en: We had a fabulous picnic beside the lake yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在湖边度过了一段美妙的野餐时光。

ex.en: Although tourism can generate fabulous wealth, its economic benefits are not always shared fairly among local residents.
ex.zh: 尽管旅游业能创造巨额财富，其经济收益却并非总能在当地居民之间公平分配。

col: a fabulous time｜极其愉快的时光
tip: 表“极好的”多用于非正式语境，语气较强。

senses.en: A person experienced in fighting, especially in the past.

ex.en: The museum displayed armour worn by an ancient warrior.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了古代战士穿过的盔甲。

ex.en: Traditional stories about warriors can reveal how past societies understood courage, loyalty, and leadership.
ex.zh: 关于战士的传统故事能够揭示过去的社会如何理解勇气、忠诚与领导力。

tip: 常用于古代战士；现代军人通常用soldier。

senses.en: According to the exact, ordinary meaning of the words.
Used to stress that something is actually true.

ex.en: He took my advice literally and bought a bigger plate.
ex.zh: 他按字面理解了我的建议，买了一个更大的盘子。

ex.en: Translating idioms literally can confuse language learners because their meanings often depend on cultural context.
ex.zh: 直译习语可能让语言学习者困惑，因为其含义往往取决于文化语境。

col: take something literally｜按字面理解某事
tip: 口语可用于夸张；正式写作宜保留字面或确实义。

senses.en: The act of discovering or noticing something difficult to find.

ex.en: Early detection of the leak saved us expensive repairs.
ex.zh: 及早发现漏水，省去了我们高昂的维修费用。

ex.en: Advances in medical imaging have improved the early detection of diseases, allowing patients to receive treatment sooner.
ex.zh: 医学影像技术的进步改善了疾病的早期检测，使患者能够更早接受治疗。

tip: 通常不可数；detection of后接被发现或检测的对象。

senses.en: A quantity of goods sent together to a destination.
The process of sending goods from one place to another.

ex.en: The shop received a fresh shipment of apples today.
ex.zh: 这家店今天收到了一批新运来的苹果。

ex.en: Delays in the shipment of essential materials can increase production costs and disrupt international supply chains.
ex.zh: 关键材料的运输延误可能增加生产成本，并扰乱国际供应链。

col: a shipment of goods｜一批货物
receive a shipment｜收到一批货物
tip: 指一批货物时可数；指装运过程时不可数。

senses.en: Someone who remains alive after danger, illness, or disaster.

ex.en: Rescuers pulled a survivor from the flooded house.
ex.zh: 救援人员从被淹的房屋中救出了一名幸存者。

ex.en: Every disaster survivor should have access to safe housing, medical treatment, and long-term psychological support.
ex.zh: 每位灾难幸存者都应能获得安全住所、医疗服务和长期心理支持。

tip: survivor指人；survival指幸存或生存。

senses.en: a mass of small bubbles on or in a liquid
a light material containing many tiny air pockets
to produce a mass of small bubbles

ex.en: White foam covered my hands as I washed the dishes.
ex.zh: 洗碗时，白色泡沫盖满了我的双手。

ex.en: Manufacturers often use foam packaging to protect fragile goods, although some types are difficult to recycle.
ex.zh: 制造商常用泡沫包装保护易碎商品，但某些泡沫材料难以回收。

tip: foam作泡沫或泡沫材料时通常不可数。

senses.en: to a very great degree or extent

ex.en: Your help made this difficult move enormously easier.
ex.zh: 你的帮助让这次艰难的搬家轻松了许多。

ex.en: Affordable public transport can benefit low-income households enormously by reducing their daily travel costs.
ex.zh: 价格实惠的公共交通可以降低日常出行成本，使低收入家庭大大受益。

tip: 常修饰形容词或动词，表示程度极高。

senses.en: a particular way of thinking about an issue
a place offering a good view of surrounding scenery

ex.en: Hearing your story helped me understand your viewpoint.
ex.zh: 听了你的经历，我更能理解你的看法了。

ex.en: Considering an issue from another person's viewpoint can help communities resolve disagreements more effectively.
ex.zh: 从他人的角度考虑问题，可以帮助社区更有效地解决分歧。

col: from my viewpoint｜从我的角度看
tip: 表示“从某人的角度看”时，搭配 from。

senses.en: Slightly wet, often in an unpleasant way.
Unwanted moisture in the air, walls, or other surfaces.
To make slightly wet or reduce strength or activity.

ex.en: My socks are still damp from yesterday's walk.
ex.zh: 昨天散步后，我的袜子到现在还潮乎乎的。

ex.en: Living in damp conditions can worsen respiratory problems, particularly among children and older people.
ex.zh: 居住环境潮湿可能加重呼吸系统问题，儿童和老年人尤其容易受影响。

col: rising damp｜沿墙上升的地面湿气
tip: damp多指令人不适的微湿；moist可用于食物润泽。

senses.en: a territory governed by another country
a group of animals or microorganisms living together

ex.en: The island was once a colony of a distant kingdom.
ex.zh: 这座岛曾是一个遥远王国的殖民地。

ex.en: Historical records reveal how trade policies shaped the economy of the colony over several decades.
ex.zh: 历史记录揭示了贸易政策如何在数十年间塑造该殖民地的经济。

tip: 既可指殖民地，也可指蚁群、鸟群或菌落。

senses.en: Expressing information clearly in few words, without unnecessary detail.

ex.en: Her concise directions helped us find the station easily.
ex.zh: 她简明的指路说明让我们轻松找到了车站。

ex.en: Clear and concise public health advice enables people to understand risks and make informed decisions quickly.
ex.zh: 清晰简明的公共卫生建议使人们能够了解风险，并迅速作出明智决定。

tip: 不仅指短，还强调信息清楚且无赘述。

senses.en: The act of being present at an event or place.
The number of people present at an event.

ex.en: Our teacher checks attendance at the start of every lesson.
ex.zh: 我们的老师每节课开始时都会点名。

ex.en: Regular school attendance is associated with stronger academic performance and better opportunities for social development.
ex.zh: 按时到校与更好的学业表现及更多社交发展机会相关。

tip: attend后直接接活动；attendance后常接at。

senses.en: Including many different kinds of people or things.

ex.en: Our garden attracts a diverse range of colourful birds.
ex.zh: 我们家的花园吸引了各种色彩鲜艳的鸟儿。

ex.en: A culturally diverse workforce can bring fresh perspectives and improve an organisation's ability to solve problems.
ex.zh: 文化背景多元的员工队伍可以带来新视角，提高组织解决问题的能力。

tip: diverse强调种类多或差异大，常修饰群体或范围。

senses.en: Doing or saying something again, often several times

ex.en: Through daily repetition, I finally remembered the whole song.
ex.zh: 通过每天反复练习，我终于记住了整首歌。

ex.en: Regular repetition can help language learners remember new vocabulary, especially when combined with meaningful practice.
ex.zh: 定期重复有助于语言学习者记住新词汇，尤其是在结合有意义的练习时。

col: learn through repetition｜通过反复练习学习
tip: repetition强调重复；rehearsal指演出前的排练。

senses.en: A person, company, or country buying goods from abroad.

ex.en: The importer showed us coffee beans from several countries.
ex.zh: 那位进口商向我们展示了来自多个国家的咖啡豆。

ex.en: A country that becomes a major food importer may face greater exposure to international price fluctuations.
ex.zh: 一个成为主要粮食进口国的国家可能更容易受到国际价格波动的影响。

col: major importer｜主要进口商；主要进口国
tip: 既可指进口商，也可指进口商品的国家。

senses.en: The state of being in a particular place.
The fact that something exists in a place or situation.
A quality that makes someone noticeable and impressive.

ex.en: Her presence at the concert made her daughter smile.
ex.zh: 她来到音乐会现场，女儿见了露出笑容。

ex.en: The presence of green spaces in urban neighbourhoods can improve residents' physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 城市社区中的绿地可以改善居民的身心健康。

col: in someone's presence｜当着某人的面
tip: in someone's presence指当着某人的面。

senses.en: Activities done for enjoyment and relaxation when not working.

ex.en: I swim for recreation at the local leisure centre.
ex.zh: 我在当地休闲中心游泳消遣。

ex.en: Access to green spaces encourages outdoor recreation and can improve both physical health and mental wellbeing.
ex.zh: 能够方便地使用绿地有助于鼓励户外休闲活动，并可改善身心健康。

tip: 表示休闲娱乐通常不可数；别与re-creation重新创造混淆。

senses.en: a clear, deep understanding of a person or situation

ex.en: Helping at the bakery gave me insight into running a business.
ex.zh: 在面包店帮忙让我深入了解了如何经营一家店。

ex.en: Interviews with local residents provide valuable insight into how urban redevelopment affects community relationships and daily routines.
ex.zh: 对当地居民的访谈有助于深入了解城市改造如何影响社区关系和日常生活。

tip: 常用insight into；泛指理解力时通常不可数。

senses.en: To mention a source or example supporting a statement.
To give something as a reason or explanation.

ex.en: Please cite the book you used for your project.
ex.zh: 请注明你做项目时参考的那本书。

ex.en: Researchers often cite access to green spaces as an important factor in improving urban residents' mental health.
ex.zh: 研究人员经常指出，能否方便地使用绿地是改善城市居民心理健康的重要因素。

col: cite as a reason｜列为理由
tip: cite是引用；site是地点；sight是视力，三者同音。

senses.en: The area of land beside a river.

ex.en: We walked along the riverside after a late lunch.
ex.zh: 我们吃过午饭后，沿着河边散步。

ex.en: Improving access to the riverside can create attractive public spaces and encourage residents to exercise outdoors.
ex.zh: 改善通往河畔的通道可以打造宜人的公共空间，鼓励居民进行户外锻炼。

tip: 常作名词定语，如 a riverside park（河滨公园）。

senses.en: A tiny piece that breaks off bread, cake, or biscuits
A very small amount of something

ex.en: A crumb fell from my toast onto the table.
ex.zh: 一粒面包屑从我的吐司上掉到了桌上。

ex.en: Even small food scraps, such as bread crumbs, can attract pests when waste is poorly managed.
ex.zh: 如果垃圾处理不当，即使是面包屑这样的小块食物残渣，也会招来害虫。

col: a crumb of comfort｜一丝安慰
tip: 可数名词；表示面包屑时常用复数crumbs。

senses.en: rising or falling at a sharp angle
describing a sharp change or an unusually high price
to leave something in liquid to release flavour or soften it

ex.en: We pushed our bikes up the steep hill.
ex.zh: 我们推着自行车爬上了陡坡。

ex.en: A steep rise in housing costs can force young workers to move away from major cities.
ex.zh: 住房成本急剧上涨可能迫使年轻劳动者离开大城市。

tip: steep既形容坡陡，也形容价格高或变化剧烈。

senses.en: to prevent someone from having something they need or value

ex.en: The noisy roadworks deprived us of sleep all week.
ex.zh: 吵闹的道路施工让我们整个星期都睡不好。

ex.en: Unequal access to technology can deprive disadvantaged students of valuable opportunities to develop essential digital skills.
ex.zh: 获取技术资源的机会不平等，可能使弱势学生失去培养必要数字技能的宝贵机会。

col: deprive someone of something｜剥夺某人的某物
deprive someone of sleep｜使某人无法睡眠
deprive someone of opportunities｜使某人失去机会
tip: 固定结构deprive sb of sth，介词用of。

senses.en: an action, especially one that is notably good or bad
a legal document proving ownership or recording an agreement

ex.en: Helping our neighbour carry groceries was a kind deed.
ex.zh: 帮邻居提食品杂货是一桩善举。

ex.en: Recognising good deeds in schools can encourage students to take greater responsibility for their local communities.
ex.zh: 学校表彰善举，可以鼓励学生为所在社区承担更多责任。

col: in word and deed｜在言语和行动上
tip: 表示行为时较正式；房产契据常用复数deeds。

senses.en: to interrupt someone's activity, rest, or peace
to make someone feel worried or upset
to move or change something from its usual position

ex.en: Please close the door quietly so you don't disturb Dad.
ex.zh: 请轻轻关门，别打扰爸爸。

ex.en: Construction noise can disturb nearby residents and reduce their quality of life over time.
ex.zh: 施工噪声可能打扰附近居民，并逐渐降低他们的生活质量。

col: disturb someone's sleep｜打扰某人睡眠
tip: disturb强调打扰或使不安；interrupt强调中断。

senses.en: To introduce a product or start an organised activity.
To send something into space or put a boat into water.
The act of introducing something or sending it into motion.

ex.en: Our local bakery launched a new delivery service yesterday.
ex.zh: 我们当地的面包店昨天推出了新的送货服务。

ex.en: Schools should launch awareness campaigns to encourage healthier eating habits and reduce food waste among students.
ex.zh: 学校应开展宣传活动，鼓励学生养成更健康的饮食习惯，并减少食物浪费。

tip: 推出产品、发起活动和发射卫星都可用launch。

senses.en: making you feel embarrassed or uncomfortable
moving clumsily or difficult to handle
difficult to deal with or manage

ex.en: There was an awkward silence after I forgot her name.
ex.zh: 我忘了她的名字，随后出现了一阵尴尬的沉默。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements can help parents manage awkward schedules without sacrificing their career opportunities.
ex.zh: 灵活的工作安排可以帮助家长应对难以协调的日程，而不必牺牲职业机会。

col: an awkward question｜难回答的问题
tip: awkward可指社交尴尬，也可指动作笨拙。

senses.en: a hospital room or section for patients receiving similar care
a local district used for administration or elections
a person legally protected by a guardian or court

ex.en: A nurse brought fresh blankets into the children's ward.
ex.zh: 一名护士把干净的毯子送进了儿科病房。

ex.en: Expanding hospital wards alone will not improve healthcare unless sufficient trained staff are also available.
ex.zh: 如果没有足够的专业医护人员，仅扩建医院病区并不能改善医疗服务。

tip: 作动词通常用ward off，表示抵挡、避开。

senses.en: to increase or improve something
something that helps increase or improve something else

ex.en: A short walk can boost your energy after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后散一小会儿步能让你更有精神。

ex.en: Investment in reliable public transport can boost local employment and improve access to essential services.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通能促进当地就业，并让人们更容易获得基本服务。

col: give something a boost｜推动某事
tip: 作及物动词，直接接销量、信心等宾语。

senses.en: to show that something exists or is likely
to direct attention to something, often by pointing

ex.en: These dark clouds indicate that rain is coming.
ex.zh: 这些乌云表明快要下雨了。

ex.en: Recent surveys indicate that affordable housing remains a major concern for young adults in urban areas.
ex.zh: 近期调查表明，经济适用住房仍是城市年轻人十分关心的问题。

tip: 表示“表明……”时，常接that从句。

senses.en: far better than usual
unusual and outside normal circumstances

ex.en: The young violinist gave an exceptional performance last night.
ex.zh: 那位年轻的小提琴手昨晚的演奏十分出色。

ex.en: Students with exceptional ability may require additional challenges to remain engaged in classroom learning.
ex.zh: 能力出众的学生可能需要更有挑战性的任务，才能持续投入课堂学习。

tip: 常指特别优秀；exceptional circumstances指特殊情况。

senses.en: The distance from a surface to the bottom.
The degree of detail, understanding, or seriousness.

ex.en: Check the depth before you jump into the pool.
ex.zh: 跳进泳池前先确认水深。

ex.en: University courses should encourage students to explore complex environmental issues in greater depth.
ex.zh: 大学课程应鼓励学生更深入地探讨复杂的环境问题。

tip: in depth表示“深入地”，不是“在深处”。

senses.en: a small screen image representing a program, file, or function

senses.zh: 代表性人物或事物；偶像
senses.en: a widely admired person or thing representing something important
a sacred image used in some Christian traditions

ex.en: Tap the camera icon to take a quick photo.
ex.zh: 点一下相机图标，快速拍张照片。

ex.en: A familiar cultural icon can attract international visitors and strengthen a city's identity in tourism campaigns.
ex.zh: 一个广为人知的文化象征可以吸引国际游客，并在旅游宣传中强化城市特色。

tip: 既可指屏幕图标，也可指有代表性的偶像或文化象征。

senses.en: involving a chance of harm, failure, or loss

ex.en: It is risky to cycle home without lights.
ex.zh: 骑车回家时不开车灯很危险。

ex.en: Investing all public funds in a single industry is risky because economic conditions can change unexpectedly.
ex.zh: 将所有公共资金投入单一产业风险很大，因为经济形势可能发生意外变化。

col: a risky strategy｜有风险的策略
tip: 常用It is risky to do sth表示做某事有风险。

senses.en: The act of keeping something safe from damage or loss.
The process of treating food to prevent it from spoiling.

ex.en: These old photographs need careful preservation to prevent further damage.
ex.zh: 这些老照片需要妥善保存，以免进一步受损。

ex.en: The preservation of historic buildings can strengthen local identity while attracting visitors and supporting small businesses.
ex.zh: 保护历史建筑可以增强地方认同感，同时吸引游客并扶持小企业。

col: a state of preservation｜保存状况
tip: 通常不可数；the preservation of后接保护对象。

senses.en: To control the direction in which a vehicle moves.
To guide someone's actions or the development of something.
A male cow castrated and usually raised for meat.

ex.en: She carefully steered the boat away from the rocks.
ex.zh: 她小心地驾驶小船，避开了岩石。

ex.en: Governments can steer investment towards renewable energy by offering financial incentives and establishing clear environmental standards.
ex.zh: 政府可以通过提供经济激励和制定明确的环境标准，引导资金投向可再生能源。

tip: steer clear of表示避开某人或某事。

senses.en: Related to business or intended to make money.
An advertisement broadcast on television or radio.

ex.en: This street has homes above its commercial premises.
ex.zh: 这条街的商业用房上面是住宅。

ex.en: Commercial development can create jobs, but it should not come at the expense of public green spaces.
ex.zh: 商业开发能够创造就业机会，但不应以牺牲公共绿地为代价。

tip: 作名词指电视或广播广告，不泛指所有广告。

senses.en: Someone injured or killed in an accident, conflict, or disaster.
Someone or something harmed by a situation or change.

ex.en: The ambulance took the casualty to a nearby hospital.
ex.zh: 救护车把伤者送往附近的医院。

ex.en: Improved building standards can reduce the number of casualties when earthquakes strike densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 当地震袭击人口稠密的城市地区时，提高建筑标准可以减少伤亡人数。

col: a casualty of the recession｜经济衰退的受害者
tip: 包括受伤者和死者，不等于仅指死亡的fatality。

senses.en: a strong desire to learn or know about something
an unusual object that attracts interest

ex.en: Curiosity led me to open the dusty wooden box.
ex.zh: 好奇心驱使我打开了那个积满灰尘的木盒。

ex.en: Schools should encourage children's curiosity by allowing them to investigate questions through practical experiments.
ex.zh: 学校应让孩子通过动手实验探究问题，从而激发他们的求知欲。

tip: 表示好奇心时不可数；表示稀奇物品时可数。

senses.en: A strong metal made mainly from iron and some carbon

senses.zh: 使做好应对困难的准备
senses.en: To prepare yourself mentally for something difficult or unpleasant

ex.en: The new bridge has a frame made of steel.
ex.zh: 这座新桥的框架是钢制的。

ex.en: Recycling steel can reduce demand for raw materials and lower energy consumption in the construction industry.
ex.zh: 回收钢材可以减少建筑业对原材料的需求，并降低能源消耗。

col: steel yourself for｜做好应对……的心理准备
tip: steel是钢，steal是偷；二者读音相同。

senses.en: To leave someone or something without intending to return.
To stop doing or pursuing something before it is finished.
A lack of restraint in expressing feelings or enjoying yourself.

ex.en: We had to abandon our car in the snow.
ex.zh: 我们不得不将车弃在雪地里。

ex.en: Cities should not abandon ambitious recycling programmes simply because initial participation rates are lower than expected.
ex.zh: 城市不应仅因初期参与率低于预期，就放弃雄心勃勃的回收计划。

tip: abandon直接接宾语；名词常见于with abandon。

senses.en: A male ruler of an empire.

ex.en: The museum displays a robe once worn by an emperor.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了一件皇帝曾穿过的袍子。

ex.en: The emperor expanded trade routes, allowing goods and cultural practices to spread across the empire.
ex.zh: 这位皇帝拓展了贸易路线，使商品和文化习俗得以在帝国各地传播。

col: crown someone emperor｜为某人加冕称帝
tip: emperor统治empire；empress指女皇或皇后。

senses.en: a brother or sister

ex.en: My younger sibling always borrows my favourite blue jacket.
ex.zh: 我家那个小的总爱借我最喜欢的蓝色夹克。

ex.en: Children with siblings may develop negotiation skills early by sharing toys and resolving disagreements at home.
ex.zh: 有兄弟姐妹的孩子可能通过分享玩具和解决家庭中的分歧，较早培养协商能力。

col: sibling rivalry｜兄弟姐妹间的竞争
tip: 可数名词，单数指一个兄弟或姐妹，不区分性别。

senses.en: Unfamiliar or very different from what someone knows or accepts
A living creature believed or imagined to come from another planet
Coming from a different country or natural environment

ex.en: The city's constant noise felt alien after our quiet village.
ex.zh: 住惯了安静的村庄后，城市持续不断的噪声让我们感到很陌生。

ex.en: Teaching methods that seem alien to international students may require careful explanation and additional support from university staff.
ex.zh: 对于国际学生感到陌生的教学方法，大学教职员工可能需要仔细解释并提供额外支持。

tip: 称外国人为alien有疏离感；通常用foreign national。

senses.en: to mix substances or qualities together
a mixture of different substances, styles, or qualities

ex.en: Blend the bananas and milk until the mixture is smooth.
ex.zh: 把香蕉和牛奶搅打至顺滑。

ex.en: Successful urban developments blend modern facilities with traditional architecture to preserve a city's distinctive character.
ex.zh: 成功的城市开发项目将现代设施与传统建筑融合，以保留城市的独特风貌。

tip: blend A with B表示将两者融合；blend in指融入。

senses.en: a situation in which there is not enough of something

ex.en: A water shortage forced us to take shorter showers.
ex.zh: 缺水迫使我们缩短淋浴时间。

ex.en: A shortage of affordable housing can force essential workers to live far from their workplaces.
ex.zh: 可负担住房短缺可能迫使关键岗位的工作人员住在远离工作地点的地方。

tip: 常用a shortage of；“缺少”也可说be short of。

senses.en: A narrow-waisted flying insect that can sting.

ex.en: A wasp landed on the edge of my glass.
ex.zh: 一只黄蜂落在了我的杯口上。

ex.en: Although wasps are often considered pests, many species help control insects that damage agricultural crops.
ex.zh: 虽然黄蜂常被视为害虫，但许多种类能帮助控制危害农作物的昆虫。

tip: wasp是黄蜂，bee是蜜蜂；两者不是同一种昆虫。

senses.en: Sudden brain damage caused by interrupted blood flow or bleeding.
One complete movement of a limb, tool, or brush.
To move your hand gently over a surface repeatedly.

ex.en: The cat purred while I stroked its soft fur.
ex.zh: 我轻抚猫咪柔软的毛，它发出了呼噜声。

ex.en: Recognising the early symptoms of a stroke can help patients receive treatment before serious brain damage occurs.
ex.zh: 识别中风的早期症状，有助于患者在出现严重脑损伤前接受治疗。

col: a swimming stroke｜游泳划水动作
tip: 中风用have a stroke，勿与心脏病发作混淆。

senses.en: A curved weapon with a string used to shoot arrows.
A knot with two loops and two loose ends.
To bend your head or body forward, often showing respect.

ex.en: She tied a neat bow around the gift box.
ex.zh: 她在礼盒上系了一个整齐的蝴蝶结。

ex.en: In some cultures, people bow when greeting others, while elsewhere a handshake is more common.
ex.zh: 在一些文化中，人们见面时会鞠躬，而在其他地方，握手更常见。

tip: 弓、蝴蝶结读/bəʊ/；鞠躬、船头读/baʊ/。

senses.en: not wanted or received with pleasure

ex.en: The loud music was an unwelcome interruption during dinner.
ex.zh: 晚餐时响起的吵闹音乐令人扫兴。

ex.en: For many residents, rising rents are an unwelcome consequence of rapid development in urban areas.
ex.zh: 对许多居民而言，租金上涨是城市快速发展带来的不受欢迎的后果。

tip: 可形容人、消息或变化；feel unwelcome指感到不受欢迎。

senses.en: A shellfish with a rough shell, sometimes producing pearls.

ex.en: The oyster shell felt rough against my fingers.
ex.zh: 牡蛎壳摸起来很粗糙。

ex.en: Restoring oyster populations can improve coastal water quality because these shellfish filter particles from the surrounding water.
ex.zh: 恢复牡蛎种群有助于改善沿海水质，因为这类贝类能过滤周围水中的颗粒物。

tip: the world is your oyster指你有无限机会。

senses.en: A place or equipment provided for a particular purpose.
A feature or service that enables a particular activity.
A natural ability to do or learn something easily.

ex.en: The new sports facility has a bright indoor pool.
ex.zh: 这座新体育设施里有一个明亮的室内泳池。

ex.en: Investing in local healthcare facilities can improve access to essential services for people in rural communities.
ex.zh: 投资当地医疗设施可以让农村社区居民更容易获得基本服务。

col: a facility for languages｜语言天赋
tip: 泛指配套设施常用复数facilities。

senses.en: a person walking rather than travelling in a vehicle
intended for or relating to people travelling on foot
ordinary and lacking imagination or excitement

ex.en: The driver stopped to let a pedestrian cross.
ex.zh: 司机停车让一位行人过马路。

ex.en: Wider pavements and safer crossings can protect pedestrians and encourage residents to walk instead of driving.
ex.zh: 更宽的人行道和更安全的过街设施可以保护行人，鼓励居民步行而非开车。

tip: 作名词指行人；作形容词也可指作品平庸乏味。

senses.en: An agreement in which each side accepts less than originally wanted.
To reach agreement by accepting less than you originally wanted.
To weaken or put something valuable at risk.

ex.en: We reached a compromise and shared the last biscuit.
ex.zh: 我们达成了折中方案，分着吃了最后一块饼干。

ex.en: Governments must find a compromise between expanding housing supply and protecting green spaces in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 政府必须在增加住房供应和保护人口密集城市的绿地之间找到折中方案。

col: a reasonable compromise｜合理的折中方案
tip: compromise on表示在某事上让步；直接接宾语可表损害。

senses.en: to increase something as much as possible or use it fully

ex.en: We added shelves to maximize space in our tiny kitchen.
ex.zh: 我们加装了架子，以充分利用小厨房的空间。

ex.en: Cities should improve public transport to maximize access to employment while reducing dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 城市应改善公共交通，尽可能增加就业机会的可及性，同时减少对私家车的依赖。

col: maximize efficiency｜最大限度提高效率
tip: 及物动词；英式也常拼作maximise。

senses.en: money paid for teaching at a school or university
teaching provided to an individual or a small group

ex.en: She works at weekends to help pay her tuition.
ex.zh: 她周末打工，帮助支付自己的学费。

ex.en: Rising university tuition fees may discourage students from disadvantaged backgrounds from pursuing higher education.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的大学学费可能使来自弱势家庭的学生放弃接受高等教育。

tip: 不可数；英式谈学费常用tuition fees。

senses.en: A shaped piece used to cover floors, walls, or roofs.
To cover a surface with tiles.

ex.en: One blue tile has cracked beside the kitchen sink.
ex.zh: 厨房水槽旁的一块蓝色瓷砖裂了。

ex.en: Using locally produced roof tiles can reduce transport emissions and support traditional industries in rural areas.
ex.zh: 使用本地生产的屋顶瓦片可以减少运输排放，并支持农村地区的传统产业。

col: tile a bathroom｜给浴室贴瓷砖
tip: 可数名词；作动词时直接接要铺砖的表面。

senses.en: to squeeze something tightly, often between a finger and thumb
a small amount held between a finger and thumb
the act of squeezing skin between a finger and thumb

ex.en: Pinch the pastry edges together to seal the pie.
ex.zh: 把面皮边缘捏合，将馅饼封好。

ex.en: As food prices rise, families on low incomes increasingly feel the pinch and reduce nonessential spending.
ex.zh: 随着食品价格上涨，低收入家庭越来越感到经济拮据，并减少非必要支出。

col: a pinch of salt｜一小撮盐
feel the pinch｜感到经济拮据
tip: a pinch of表少量；feel the pinch指手头紧。

senses.en: in a way that meets expectations or requirements

ex.en: The washing machine worked satisfactorily after the repair.
ex.zh: 修理之后，洗衣机运转正常，令人满意。

ex.en: Public transport cannot function satisfactorily unless local authorities invest in regular maintenance and staff training.
ex.zh: 除非地方政府投入资金进行定期维护和员工培训，否则公共交通无法良好运转。

tip: 表示达到要求，不一定是表现出色。

senses.en: able to spread between people, like an illness or emotion

ex.en: Her laughter was catching, and soon everyone was smiling.
ex.zh: 她的笑声很有感染力，很快大家都笑了。

ex.en: Although enthusiasm can be catching, public health campaigns also need clear evidence to encourage lasting behavioural change.
ex.zh: 尽管热情能够感染他人，公共卫生宣传仍需明确证据来促成持久的行为改变。

col: a catching illness｜会传染的疾病
tip: 多作表语；形容曲调朗朗上口用catchy，而非catching。

senses.en: to experience a process, change, or treatment

ex.en: My uncle will undergo knee surgery early next week.
ex.zh: 我叔叔下周初将接受膝盖手术。

ex.en: Many coastal cities will undergo significant changes as rising sea levels force governments to reconsider urban planning.
ex.zh: 随着海平面上升迫使政府重新考虑城市规划，许多沿海城市将经历重大变化。

col: undergo significant changes｜经历重大变化
tip: 过去式underwent，过去分词undergone；直接接宾语。

senses.en: A ship designed to carry large quantities of liquid
A road vehicle carrying liquids or gases in a large tank

ex.en: We watched a huge tanker sail into the harbour.
ex.zh: 我们看着一艘巨大的油轮驶入港口。

ex.en: An accident involving an oil tanker can cause lasting damage to coastal ecosystems.
ex.zh: 涉及油轮的事故可能对沿海生态系统造成持久损害。

tip: tank可指储罐；tanker指运输液体等的船或车辆。

senses.en: Sudden pain caused by a muscle tightening involuntarily.
To restrict someone's movement, freedom, or ability to act.

ex.en: A sudden cramp in my calf stopped me swimming.
ex.zh: 小腿突然抽筋，我只好停止游泳。

ex.en: Excessively strict classroom rules may cramp students' creativity and discourage them from exploring unfamiliar ideas.
ex.zh: 过于严格的课堂规则可能束缚学生的创造力，使他们不愿探索陌生的想法。

col: cramp someone's style｜束缚某人的发挥
tip: 表示空间狭窄用cramped，不用cramp作形容词。

senses.en: a reason for doing something

ex.en: Her motive for joining was simply to make friends.
ex.zh: 她加入的动机只是想交朋友。

ex.en: Financial security is a major motive for many graduates who choose careers in established companies.
ex.zh: 经济保障是许多毕业生选择到成熟企业就业的主要动机。

col: motive for doing something｜做某事的动机
tip: motive强调行动背后的原因，常接for。

senses.en: to give someone what they want or need
to meet a condition, standard, or requirement
to convince someone that something is true or acceptable

ex.en: A bowl of soup was enough to satisfy my hunger.
ex.zh: 一碗汤就足以让我不再饥饿。

ex.en: New housing developments must satisfy strict environmental standards before local authorities allow construction to begin.
ex.zh: 新住宅开发项目必须达到严格的环境标准，地方政府才会批准开工。

tip: 人感到满意用satisfied；事物令人满意用satisfying。

senses.en: A change that fixes an error, or the act of fixing it.

ex.en: I made a correction before sending the email.
ex.zh: 我在发送邮件前改正了一处错误。

ex.en: Timely correction of factual errors helps news organizations maintain public trust and prevent misinformation from spreading.
ex.zh: 及时纠正事实错误有助于新闻机构维持公众信任，并防止错误信息传播。

tip: 具体一处修改可数；泛指纠正过程时常不可数。

senses.en: to find or direct the way to a destination
to move around a website or digital system
to deal successfully with a complicated situation

ex.en: We used a map to navigate the narrow streets.
ex.zh: 我们借助地图在狭窄的街道间找路。

ex.en: Clear website design helps users navigate public services and access essential information without unnecessary delays.
ex.zh: 清晰的网站设计帮助用户查找公共服务并获取必要信息，避免不必要的耽搁。

col: navigate through traffic｜穿行于车流中
navigate unfamiliar terrain｜在陌生地形中找路
tip: 可直接接地点或网站，也可用 navigate through。

senses.en: Evaluated the quality, value, extent, or importance of something.

ex.en: The mechanic assessed the damage before repairing my bicycle.
ex.zh: 修理工先评估了损坏情况，然后才修我的自行车。

ex.en: Students should be assessed through varied tasks rather than judged solely on their performance in final examinations.
ex.zh: 应通过多种任务评估学生，而不是仅凭期末考试表现作出判断。

col: be assessed on｜根据……接受评估
tip: 是assess的过去式和过去分词，词尾读/st/。

senses.en: Relating to sight or things that can be seen.
An image used to explain something or attract attention.

ex.en: The exhibition combines music with some stunning visual effects.
ex.zh: 这场展览将音乐与一些惊艳的视觉效果结合起来。

ex.en: Teachers can use visual aids to make complex scientific concepts easier for younger students to understand.
ex.zh: 教师可以使用视觉教具，让年龄较小的学生更容易理解复杂的科学概念。

tip: visual表示与视觉有关；“栩栩如生”通常用vivid。

senses.en: to catch someone or something and prevent escape
to record an image, sound, or particular quality
the act of catching someone or something

ex.en: Rescuers captured the injured bird and gently examined its wing.
ex.zh: 救援人员捉住那只受伤的鸟，轻轻检查了它的翅膀。

ex.en: Wildlife researchers use remote cameras to capture animal behaviour without disturbing natural habitats.
ex.zh: 野生动物研究人员使用遥控摄像机记录动物行为，避免干扰自然栖息地。

tip: 拍摄影像、捕捉气氛也可用capture。

senses.en: a separate unit within a larger course of study
a separate part of a machine, system, or software

ex.en: We finished the photography module with an outdoor project.
ex.zh: 我们以一个户外项目完成了摄影单元的学习。

ex.en: Universities increasingly offer a compulsory module on digital skills to prepare students for changing workplace demands.
ex.zh: 越来越多的大学开设数字技能必修模块，以帮助学生应对不断变化的职场需求。

col: complete a module｜完成一个课程单元
tip: 课程中的module是独立单元，通常包含多节课。

senses.en: A tendency to become angry, or an angry mood.
Make something less strong, extreme, or severe.
Treat metal with heat to give it suitable hardness and toughness.

ex.en: He lost his temper when the drawer jammed again.
ex.zh: 抽屉又卡住了，他大发脾气。

ex.en: Governments should temper enthusiasm for new technologies with careful consideration of their potential social consequences.
ex.zh: 政府应认真考虑新技术可能带来的社会后果，避免一味热衷于推广。

col: temper enthusiasm with caution｜以谨慎节制热情
tip: lose your temper 是发脾气；动词常用 temper A with B。

senses.zh: 会说两种语言的；双语的
senses.en: Able to use two languages, or involving two languages.

senses.zh: 熟练使用两种语言的人
senses.en: Someone who can use two languages fluently.

ex.en: Our bilingual neighbour speaks both English and Chinese fluently.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居精通双语，英语和中文都说得很流利。

ex.en: Bilingual education can help children maintain their cultural identity while developing skills for an increasingly connected world.
ex.zh: 双语教育有助于孩子保持文化认同，同时培养适应日益互联世界所需的技能。

tip: 表示精通哪两种语言，可用bilingual in A and B。

senses.en: unwanted involvement in someone else's affairs or decisions
an action or influence that disrupts an activity or process
unwanted signals that reduce the quality of electronic reception

ex.en: I wanted to choose my clothes without anyone's interference.
ex.zh: 我想自己挑选衣服，不受任何人干涉。

ex.en: Universities need protection from political interference to ensure that research findings remain independent and credible.
ex.zh: 大学需要免受政治干预，以确保研究成果保持独立和可信。

col: interference in domestic affairs｜干涉内政
interference with sleep｜对睡眠的干扰
tip: in多接事务指干涉；with多接活动指妨碍。

senses.en: to become less strong, or make something less strong

ex.en: Too little sleep can weaken your ability to concentrate.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足会削弱你的专注能力。

ex.en: Persistent unemployment can weaken local economies by reducing household spending and discouraging business investment.
ex.zh: 持续失业会减少家庭支出并抑制企业投资，从而削弱地方经济。

col: weaken the immune system｜削弱免疫系统
weaken an argument｜削弱论点的说服力
tip: 既可及物也可不及物：使变弱或自身变弱。

senses.en: a wide street, often lined with trees
a possible way to achieve something or solve a problem

ex.en: We walked along a quiet avenue shaded by tall trees.
ex.zh: 我们沿着一条高树成荫的安静大道散步。

ex.en: Online learning offers an important avenue for adults seeking new skills while remaining in full-time employment.
ex.zh: 在线学习为希望在全职工作期间掌握新技能的成年人提供了一条重要途径。

col: explore every avenue｜探索一切途径
tip: 比喻义常见avenue for/of，表示途径。

senses.en: In most cases or on most occasions.
In a way that shows the usual qualities of something.

ex.en: Our neighbours typically walk their dog before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居通常在早餐前遛狗。

ex.en: Cities with reliable public transport typically experience less traffic congestion than those dependent on private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通可靠的城市通常比依赖私家车的城市交通拥堵更少。

tip: 通常放在实义动词前、be动词后。

senses.en: smooth, attractive movement or behaviour
extra time or kindness freely given
make a place or occasion more attractive by being present

ex.en: The dancer moved across the stage with effortless grace.
ex.zh: 那位舞者轻盈优雅地穿过舞台。

ex.en: A short grace period can help households manage unexpected delays in receiving their income.
ex.zh: 短暂的宽限期可以帮助家庭应对收入意外延迟到账的情况。

tip: grace 表优雅通常不可数；grace period 指宽限期。

senses.en: Likely to move, fall, or collapse.
Likely to change suddenly and unpredictably.

ex.en: This unstable chair wobbles whenever I sit on it.
ex.zh: 这把椅子不稳，我一坐上去就晃。

ex.en: An unstable economy can discourage investment and make long-term planning difficult for small businesses.
ex.zh: 经济不稳定会抑制投资，并使小企业难以制定长期计划。

tip: 可指物体不稳，也可指经济、局势等易变。

senses.en: Able to strongly affect people's opinions, decisions, or actions.

ex.en: Her grandfather was an influential teacher in their village.
ex.zh: 她的祖父曾是村里一位很有影响力的教师。

ex.en: Scientific advisers can be influential in shaping government policies on public health and environmental protection.
ex.zh: 科学顾问可以在制定公共卫生和环境保护政策方面发挥重要影响。

col: influential in shaping policy｜对政策制定有影响力
tip: 常用be influential in doing，表示对某事有影响。

senses.en: Willingness to give money, time, or help freely.
Willingness to be kind and forgiving towards others.

ex.en: Thanks to your generosity, everyone has a warm coat.
ex.zh: 多亏你的慷慨相助，每个人都有了一件暖和的外套。

ex.en: Community projects often depend on the generosity of residents who contribute both money and valuable practical skills.
ex.zh: 社区项目往往依靠居民的慷慨支持，他们既捐款，也贡献宝贵的实用技能。

col: an act of generosity｜慷慨之举
generosity towards others｜对他人的慷慨
tip: 通常不可数；一次慷慨之举用an act of generosity。

senses.en: A plant with large, often trumpet-shaped flowers.

ex.en: A white lily opened beside our kitchen window this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，我们厨房窗边的一朵白百合开了。

ex.en: Urban gardens planted with lilies and other flowering species can provide attractive spaces for local residents.
ex.zh: 种有百合和其他开花植物的城市花园能为当地居民提供宜人的空间。

tip: 复数为lilies；water lily指睡莲。

senses.en: Having large, strong muscles.
Relating to the muscles of the body.

ex.en: The muscular swimmer lifted the heavy box easily.
ex.zh: 那位肌肉发达的游泳运动员轻松举起了沉重的箱子。

ex.en: Regular resistance training can improve muscular strength and help older adults maintain their independence.
ex.zh: 定期进行抗阻训练可以增强肌肉力量，帮助老年人保持独立生活的能力。

tip: 既可指肌肉发达，也可仅表示与肌肉有关。

senses.en: A child or young person.

ex.en: A cheerful youngster helped me pick up the apples.
ex.zh: 一个开朗的孩子帮我捡起了那些苹果。

ex.en: Community sports programmes give youngsters opportunities to develop teamwork skills and build friendships outside school.
ex.zh: 社区体育项目让青少年有机会培养团队协作能力，并在校外建立友谊。

col: a group of youngsters｜一群孩子
tip: 男女皆可指，语气较随意；正式写作可用young people。

senses.en: a very strong interest in someone or something

ex.en: She watched the tiny fish with fascination for hours.
ex.zh: 她着迷地看着那些小鱼，一看就是几个小时。

ex.en: Children's fascination with wildlife can provide a valuable starting point for environmental education in primary schools.
ex.zh: 孩子们对野生动物的浓厚兴趣，可以为小学环境教育提供宝贵的切入点。

col: hold a fascination for｜对……有吸引力
tip: 对某物着迷用 fascination with；看得入迷用 with fascination。

senses.en: A school or class for children beginning their education

ex.en: My daughter painted a bright yellow bird at kindergarten.
ex.zh: 我女儿在幼儿园画了一只鲜黄色的小鸟。

ex.en: High-quality kindergarten education can develop children's social skills and prepare them for more structured learning.
ex.zh: 优质的学前教育能培养儿童的社交能力，为更系统的学习做好准备。

tip: 美式常指小学前的一年；英式幼儿园常用nursery。

senses.en: A distinct period in a process of change or development.
One of the changing shapes of the moon as seen.
To introduce or remove something gradually in planned stages.

ex.en: The kitchen repairs have entered their final phase.
ex.zh: 厨房维修已进入最后阶段。

ex.en: During the initial phase of urban development, planners should prioritise affordable housing and reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 在城市发展的初期阶段，规划者应优先考虑可负担住房和可靠的公共交通。

col: a phase of development｜发展阶段
tip: phase in指逐步引入，phase out指逐步淘汰。

senses.en: a person who controls a machine or piece of equipment
a person or company that runs a business or service
a person who connects calls or provides telephone assistance

ex.en: The crane operator carefully lowered the beam into place.
ex.zh: 起重机操作员小心地把横梁降到指定位置。

ex.en: Every public transport operator should ensure that its services remain accessible to passengers with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 每家公共交通运营商都应确保行动不便的乘客能够使用其服务。

col: mobile network operator｜移动网络运营商
tip: 既指操作设备的人，也指经营服务的公司。

senses.en: Someone or something that causes great admiration or surprise
To feel great surprise or admiration

ex.en: We marvelled at the tiny bird's beautifully woven nest.
ex.zh: 那只小鸟精巧编织的巢让我们惊叹不已。

ex.en: The new bridge is an engineering marvel that connects isolated communities and improves access to essential services.
ex.zh: 这座新桥是一项工程奇迹，连接了偏远社区，并让居民更方便地获得基本服务。

col: a marvel of nature｜自然奇观
tip: 动词常接at；英式过去式marvelled，美式marveled。

senses.en: to use rude or offensive words
to make a serious promise or insist something is true

ex.en: Please don't swear when the game goes wrong.
ex.zh: 玩游戏不顺利时，请不要说脏话。

ex.en: Witnesses must swear to tell the truth before giving evidence in many legal systems.
ex.zh: 在许多法律体系中，证人作证前必须宣誓如实陈述。

col: swear to do something｜发誓做某事
tip: 过去式swore，过去分词sworn；swear at指咒骂。

senses.en: A short account presenting the main features of a subject.

ex.en: Our guide gave us an overview of the tour.
ex.zh: 导游向我们简要介绍了游览安排。

ex.en: The opening section provides an overview of the main challenges facing renewable energy development.
ex.zh: 开篇部分概述了可再生能源发展面临的主要挑战。

tip: 通常作可数名词；搭配an overview of。

senses.en: the process of finding people to join an organisation

ex.en: Our cafe handles recruitment before the busy summer season.
ex.zh: 我们咖啡馆会在繁忙的夏季到来之前招聘员工。

ex.en: Fair recruitment practices help employers attract talented applicants from a wide range of social backgrounds.
ex.zh: 公平的招聘方式有助于雇主吸引来自不同社会背景的优秀求职者。

tip: 通常不可数；招聘某类人员用recruitment of。

senses.en: Not very serious, important, or large.
A person younger than the legal age of adulthood.
Using a musical scale often associated with a sad sound.

ex.en: The bike only needs a few minor repairs.
ex.zh: 这辆自行车只需要稍作修理。

ex.en: Minor changes to daily travel habits can collectively reduce pollution in densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 日常出行习惯的小改变，累积起来可以减少人口密集城区的污染。

tip: minor injury指轻伤；名词a minor指未成年人。

senses.en: To examine facts carefully to discover what happened or why.
To study a subject carefully to learn more about it.

ex.en: A plumber came to investigate the strange noise upstairs.
ex.zh: 一位水管工来查明楼上怪声的原因。

ex.en: Researchers are investigating how access to green spaces affects the mental health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 研究人员正在探究接触绿地如何影响城市居民的心理健康。

tip: 直接接调查对象：investigate the problem，不加into。

senses.en: To make something clear through examples or evidence.
To provide pictures for a book or other publication.

ex.en: She used two jars to illustrate the difference.
